subject: None of these cases are about fairness

body:
The lawsuit the Supreme Court agreed to hear isn't about fairness. It's not about so-called "election integrity," because millions of taxpayers' dollars have been wasted on state investigations looking for mail-in ballot fraud that simply does not exist.
This lawsuit is a political ploy to suppress legitimate mail-in ballots that are postmarked by Election Day and potentially delayed by the U.S. Postal Service. This lawsuit targets our fellow citizens who have done nothing wrong and might have their vote suppressed through delays out of their control. And it's all because the political party that brought the lawsuit knows that those delayed ballots are more likely to have been cast by voters for the other party and not themselves.
We cannot let anyone get away with such a cynical attempt at hidden voter suppression, no matter who controls the Supreme Court. RUSH $35 or more right now to help us spread the word about this lawsuit and defend the right to vote across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042126_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
DemocracyDocket: SCOTUS to Hear GOP Lawsuit That Could Radically Restrict Mail Voting [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042126_3&amount=25]
Team: Mail-in ballots are under attack again.
The Supreme Court agreed to hear arguments in RNC v. Wetzel, a lawsuit challenging Mississippi’s law allowing a five-day grace period for late-arriving ballots mailed by Election Day. In simpler terms, it's a case about whether your vote will count if you mail it on or before Election Day, but your ballot arrives after Election Day.
It's clear why a political party -- in this case, the Republican National Committee (RNC) -- is claiming that states must reject ballots that arrive after Election Day. Doing so would potentially disenfranchise a large number of voters, restricting the number of participants in an election. And the data is clear, over the last several election cycles, Republicans have been outnumbered in the use of mail-in ballots.
The RNC is making a blunt decision that their ability to win elections matters more than your vote. It's a cynical attempt to stay in power by suppressing ballots that are delivered late by the postal service. It's the kind of partisan work that shows they'd rather believe in their own power and control than the principles of democracy, of a country where all our votes should count, regardless of party.
Team: We cannot allow blatant partisanship to overrule our right to vote. Help make every mail-in ballot count in Mississippi and beyond with $35 or whatever you can today to make every voice heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042126_3&amount=35]

Our position is clear: If your ballot was postmarked by Election Day, it should count.
This shouldn't be a partisan question. No political party -- Democrat, Republican, Green, Working Families, Libertarian, Reform, Conservative -- should be against voting. No party in our democracy should want to restrict the fundamental right of our fellow citizens to make their voice heard through voting.
But now we're facing a case where the Supreme Court’s decision could strike down or uphold laws in 16 states (and Washington D.C.) allowing late-arriving ballots postmarked on or before Election Day to be counted if they arrive within a set grace period.
How do we know what is at stake? Data from the 2024 Massachusetts elections shows that their three-day grace period for ballots to arrive after Election Day resulted in a 60% drop in rejected ballots as compared to no grace period. That means thousands of votes still counted, more than 1.5% of the total vote count. In a close election, that 1.5% could easily mean the difference between winning and losing.
Our fundamental right to vote should matter so much more than a partisan desperation to win. Chip in $35 or whatever you can to help us defend the use of mail-in ballots and make every vote count in elections nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=042126_3&amount=35]

[_**In a moment, I’m going to ask you to chip in to help us win this race.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129914619/615976639/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_FR_CecileRichardsRS_260421_i_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjlhNTk4YTMtZGUzZC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WvdykMIUdllcoj1yUJhkkddrDTO_F6Y8wSViyAQu2hE=) But first, I want to tell you about a moment that changed everything for me.

After _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, I was furious, heartbroken, and honestly questioning whether I could call Texas home anymore given how hostile it is to women like me.

So I went to the Texas Capitol to protest. And that’s when I happened to run into one of my lifelong heroes, Cecile Richards – the former president of Planned Parenthood, and one of the defining voices for women’s rights in this country.

I told her I had just moved back to Texas from D.C., and how devastated I was by what was happening.

She looked at me and said something I’ll never forget: _**“Thank you for moving back. We need you here.”**_ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129914620/615976640/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_FR_CecileRichardsRS_260421_i_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjlhNTk4YTMtZGUzZC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WvdykMIUdllcoj1yUJhkkddrDTO_F6Y8wSViyAQu2hE=) That moment stayed with me.

Because it made something click: **I’m not the kind of person who walks away when things get hard.**

So I gave up my apartment, put everything in storage, and spent six months working and living wherever I could just to save enough money to run for Congress. I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines while our rights were being taken away.

[_**And now, I’m asking you to be part of what comes next. Can you join my campaign with a donation of $5 or $10 today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129914621/615976641/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_FR_CecileRichardsRS_260421_i_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjlhNTk4YTMtZGUzZC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WvdykMIUdllcoj1yUJhkkddrDTO_F6Y8wSViyAQu2hE=)

Because this race isn’t just about one seat. It’s about who gets to make decisions for women in Texas and across this country.

Right now, those decisions are being made by people who don’t care to understand what’s at stake for women. The only way that changes is if we change who’s in power. And this race will help decide that.

If we win, I will be the first woman and Latina to represent TX-21, and the first woman in American history to serve in Congress with a STEM PhD. That means having someone in the room who will actually fight for women, protect our rights, and base decisions on facts – not extremist ideologies.

**We have a chance to make history.**

[_**Will you chip in $10 or $15 today to help us win this race and send a new kind of leadership to Congress?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129914622/615976642/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_FR_CecileRichardsRS_260421_i_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjlhNTk4YTMtZGUzZC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WvdykMIUdllcoj1yUJhkkddrDTO_F6Y8wSViyAQu2hE=)

With Gratitude,
Dr. Kristin Hook [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129914623/615976643/-1456264782?refcode=KH_ATA_EM_FR_CecileRichardsRS_260421_i_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjlhNTk4YTMtZGUzZC1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=WvdykMIUdllcoj1yUJhkkddrDTO_F6Y8wSViyAQu2hE=)

Peter,
After January 6th, we saw exactly what was at stake.
Extremists attacked our elections. They threatened election workers, spread lies, and tried to take control.
As Secretary of State, I took action. We made it a crime to threaten election workers. We banned guns near polling places. We protected Colorado’s democracy.
And when Tina Peters tried to interfere with our elections, I removed her from direct election oversight and helped make sure she was held accountable.
I was told to stay quiet. That going after Trump and his allies was “too partisan.”
So I got even louder. If we don’t stand up when democracy is on the line, then what are we doing?
I’ve never backed down from a tough fight. And I’m not about to start now.
I’m running for Attorney General because Colorado deserves someone who won’t back down from extremists, won’t take orders from party leaders, and won’t stay silent when it matters most.
But building a campaign that can win statewide takes resources. Can you chip in today to help us keep fighting and win this race? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2604-q2-jg?]

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: The USPS is failing us, again
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| Wisconsin needs the postal service, and we need it to work.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5373%2E35263%2E5-Vopo)
Peter, Delays and staffing shortages at post offices across Wisconsin just keep getting worse, and I'm demanding answers from the Postmaster General. Donald Trump decimated the agency during his first term by appointing Postmaster General Louis DeJoy, and the problems DeJoy caused are getting worse — even though he’s been replaced. The latest unacceptable delay meant that **269 people were denied their vote this month**. The post office is supposed to deliver absentee ballots throughout the day on Election Day to make sure everyone’s vote is counted. They failed, getting 269 mail-in ballots to officials the day after the election, when they couldn’t be counted. This is not the first time I have demanded answers from the USPS about mail delivery issues on behalf of my constituents. Millions of Wisconsinites rely on the Postal Service to stay in touch with loved ones, pay bills, receive much-needed medications, and cast their vote. We have a duty to find solutions to these difficulties for the people we serve. **[Please join me in calling for answers from the USPS.](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/signup/2604_usps_petition?refcode=AU_STB_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20260421_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=5373%2E35263%2E5-Vopo)

**Hobbs Blocks State Agency Transparency Reform** In late December 2024 I worked with Americans for Prosperity on [Senate Bill 1627](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a2a4c035de&e=a7ab36849c) to ensure state agencies provide clear, consistent guidance on their websites when interpreting federal rules and regulations. Sadly, after it passed the Senate in 2025, the chairman of the House Committee on Regulatory Oversight refused to add it to his committee agenda. This session, I sponsored [Senate Bill 1586](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=17868a5862&e=a7ab36849c) which is very similar to last year’s SB1627. This year it got heard and voted on in both legislative chambers. Sadly, Hobbs also vetoed the bill last week. In her veto letter, the governor claimed the bill was “too broad,” despite its straightforward goal of improving transparency and preventing agencies from mischaracterizing federal requirements. This commonsense reform would have helped Arizona families, businesses, and taxpayers better understand how federal rules and regulations are applied at the state level. This reform was designed to prevent agencies from overstating or mischaracterizing federal rules — a problem that can create confusion, unnecessary compliance burdens, and inconsistent application of the law. SB1586 would have made it easier for everyday Arizonans to better understand how federal rules affect issues like healthcare, education, licensing, and public benefits. When agency websites provide conflicting or unclear information, families often struggle to know what is required of them. SB1586 aimed to ensure that the information they rely on is transparent, reliable, and grounded in actual federal law. For small businesses, SB1586 would have reduced regulatory uncertainty. Employers, contractors, and small businesses depend on accurate guidance to plan, budget, and comply with federal requirements. When agencies interpret rules inconsistently or publish unclear explanations online, businesses can face unnecessary costs, delays, or legal exposure. SB 1586 would have helped create a more predictable regulatory environment by ensuring agencies “speak with one clear voice” when explaining federal rules. I remain committed to advancing policies that strengthen accountability and ensure Arizonans receive accurate, reliable information from their government. SB1586 was intended to strengthen transparency, improve accountability, and give both families and businesses confidence that state agencies are providing accurate, consistent information — helping Arizonans navigate federal requirements without confusion or unnecessary barriers. Thank you for staying engaged and informed. Derek, I will never forget the trauma of Jan. 6, 2021. The mob outside. Insurrectionists storming the Capitol building and breaking doors and windows to get in. The urgent discussions between members of Congress deciding how to protect ourselves and ensure that the work of counting the electoral votes went on. That was a direct, violent attack on our democracy. Now, Trump’s Department of Justice is compounding it with an attack on the rule of law: it is moving to overturn the convictions of the white nationalist leaders who led the mob in a violent effort to overturn a free and fair election. **Is there no justice left? The Department of Justice should be pursuing accountability, cracking down on corruption, and defending the Constitution. But under this administration, the DOJ is a tool for attacking enemies and covering up wrongdoing. Someone has to stand up to this abuse of power, to defend our country and its people. clean_body: | Trump and his DOJ are letting the people who tried to undermine our institutions get away with serious crimes. Derek, I will never forget the trauma of Jan. 6, 2021. The mob outside. Insurrectionists storming the Capitol building and breaking doors and windows to get in. The urgent discussions between members of Congress deciding how to protect ourselves and ensure that the work of counting the electoral votes went on. That was a direct, violent attack on our democracy. Now, Trump’s Department of Justice is compounding it with an attack on the rule of law: it is moving to overturn the convictions of the white nationalist leaders who led the mob in a violent effort to overturn a free and fair election. Is there no justice left? Is there nothing Trump won’t pervert? Using the DOJ to do the dirty work for the administration is apparently the job of Trump’s FOX News transplants in the department, people like Jeanine Pirro, now serving as US Attorney for the District of Columbia. Could this DOJ be more of a farce? I spent almost six years in the Department of Justice, when it actually stood for justice, when it was ruthlessly nonpartisan, and it breaks my heart to see what it’s become. The Department of Justice should be pursuing accountability, cracking down on corruption, and defending the Constitution. But under this administration, the DOJ is a tool for attacking enemies and covering up wrongdoing. Someone has to stand up to this abuse of power, to defend our country and its people. Someone has to fight back. I have and I always will. Because this fight isn’t over. It’s just beginning, and I won’t back down. It’s official:
The people of Virginia voted tonight to unrig the midterms. We voted to restore our Constitutional system of checks and balances. Virginians just voted to approve new maps.
And that means I’m officially running to represent the new Sixth District, the closest House seat in Virginia. As of tonight, I am the front-runner to be the first Democrat in a generation to turn the Blue Ridge blue!
Our race could decide whether Dems win a House majority, and it is going to be close. We have been barnstorming the district, from Charlottesville to the Shenandoah and Roanoke to Radford. We are racking up local endorsements from over 50 elected officials and community leaders. We are ahead in early polling and building a grassroots army of volunteers and donors.
Will you be a become a day-one donor of our official campaign to flip VA-6? VP Harris only won this district with 50.6%. We need your help NOW to be prepared to put this key district in the win column in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/perriello-em?amount=50]
At my launch in December, I promised that we would be ready to win whatever district Virginia voters chose to give us. Now, we know that victory runs through the Blue Ridge Mountains , and the 18 universities and community colleges stretching from the Piedmont to the Shenandoah, Roanoke, and New River Valleys.
These amazing, resilient communities deserve better that being represented by Ben Cline. Peter, Something historic happened in New Orleans last fall: a wrongfully incarcerated man won the Criminal Clerk seat in New Orleans with 68% of the vote.
That man is Calvin Duncan. He was charged as a teenager for a crime he did not commit and escaped death row at Louisiana's notorious Angola prison by being his own jailhouse lawyer. He fought for his exoneration, became a lawyer, and ran for Criminal Clerk of Court in New Orleans, winning with 38,000 people standing behind him.
After this landmark victory, history started to repeat itself in Louisiana. Republicans began plotting to ensure Calvin Duncan would never get sworn in.
---
| [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015e3Fh0qG9u-nT0KPQW9VMCXTLCIQcsgqx1c2EphjB72abGZcNKM8iibuMWVV9fS1N1DVUCLGpnqETA62NCdVrPJvpIK8cH8_Vn7WWHYaQoVhfh_TKPdennS1OIy7J9LXLMwsFW-K_aov116bQqqcBQIBi4I6VyJNOyl9TOZ6uEQUTT3EYkighaXdNl9AipOAw5WQLLfpZ1p7PbFA8x4i5_EBuQcYBcrc&c=_H6gXcMzxcqfxJrH74O8H8lz7xEv2_pwk9_On16BiVfzK2e6_rEI_g==&ch=Npd1fH6bwJGPaZQQsflGGOvCK3zbijdyRoI5YjOgm4YZKpD-CN5OCQ==)
---
Sadly, this is the norm in Louisiana history -- duly elected black men being denied their rightfully won seats by racist lawmakers.
Look no further than the story of P.B.S. Pinchback, an emancipated black man who, during Reconstruction, helped draft the Louisiana Constitution, served as the Louisiana Senate Pro Tempore, and, when the Lieutenant Governor died, he took his seat; when the Governor was impeached, he became the first black Governor in United States history.
But, like Calvin Duncan, P.B.S. Pinchback was a threat to the status quo, and when he was sent to serve in the United States Senate, they refused to swear him in and seat him.
My name is Jamie Davis, I'm the Democrat running for US Senate in Louisiana. I'm a black farmer, and today I farm the same Louisiana delta soil that my ancestors worked as slaves and sharecroppers, but now I own the land and am farming over 3000 acres.
The same things they did to P.B.S and Calvin are about to happen to me.
MAGA just announced they will purge 500,000+ voters from the rolls in Louisiana and are about to sign into law a bill that would refuse poor voters without IDs the ability to sign affidavits at the polls, allowing them to vote. They know the blue wave is coming to Louisiana and they are doing everything to ensure I don't flip our US Senate Seat in November.
History has the answer to what is happening here, because there are forces in Louisiana that want to see history repeat itself, and there are people in Louisiana working to make history: people like Calvin, people like me.
And there are people like you who know that justice will triumph as long as we continue to stand with each other. body:
No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

| | | [View this email in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgrb1h6178crpsl43u0ae2d7bfofkb03k5u54ef8_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c3hmcpr4c5h2bs)

Friend,

No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons — good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election — the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged — not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin — one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington — filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side’s attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight — early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response — on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Friend.

Our goal is to raise at least $120,000 this week to defend the 12 individuals involved.

Every dollar you give helps protect the rule of law, push back against leftist interference, and stand in the gap for these American patriots.

[Please help us fight this battle by donating today.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zj8e8mfuaqf81sp0connbabat3u6edkundhasnmg_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c3hmcpr4c5h2bs) Or keep reading to learn exactly who these individuals are — many of them veterans — why they were unfairly targeted, and why this fight matters to every conservative who believes in fairness and justice.
[Donate](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvbeek07r6t5mp0913gtc2qq5hk8lnbs2g4biio0_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c3hmcpr4c5h2bs)
**These were the patriots that the Biden DOJ pursued the hardest with politically charged trials. **
* **Stewart Rhodes (Veteran),** founder and leader of the Oath Keepers, was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years in prison.
* **Kelly Meggs** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 12 years.
* **Kenneth Harrelson (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 4 years.
* **Jessica Watkins (Veteran)** was convicted of related felony charges and sentenced to 8.5 years.
* **Roberto Minuta,** Edward Vallejo (Veteran), Joseph Hackett, and David Moerschel were all convicted of seditious conspiracy after their own months-long trial and received substantial prison sentences with federal terrorism enhancements.
* **Ethan Nordean** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 18 years.
* **Joseph Biggs (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 17 years.
* **Zachary Rehl (Veteran)** was convicted of seditious conspiracy and sentenced to 15 years.
* **Dominic Pezzola (Veteran)** was convicted of serious felony charges in the same case and sentenced to 10 years.

These individuals should never have been targeted with inflated seditious conspiracy charges in the first place.

Now, the Trump administration is finally moving to correct this injustice and vacate the convictions.

**But Raskin is fighting tooth and nail to stop it. **

He is demanding the court appoint a special lawyer (an independent amicus) to oppose the DOJ and defend the old jury verdicts — _essentially trying to keep the deep state’s narrative alive and continue punishing these patriots_.

**This need is especially urgent.**

These patriots are broke and still fighting on multiple fronts. They cannot afford to pay lawyers to defend against this latest leftist attack themselves.

[Friend, any assistance you can provide will be greatly appreciated. Please click below to help us stand in the gap for these men and women right now.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr2g215840008lsf7e4igfq9buct0f0c9ggdub9g_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c3hmcpr4c5h2bs)

[Donate $1,000](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zl52mgt296amd76s3c71mth9eok6gedkrnhfcngg_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c3hmcpr4c5h2bs)

Even if you’re unable to give financially right now, your prayers for these patriots, for wisdom in the courtroom, and for protection against political persecution are always powerful and deeply appreciated.

Thank you for your time, consideration, and continued support of conservative values and American justice.

In solidarity,

Shane Jenkins
Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap

P.S. This is exactly the kind of emergency Stand in the Gap was built to handle.

Even after President Trump commuted their sentences, many of our brothers and sisters are still struggling to rebuild their lives. They endured prison, lost jobs, homes, friends, and family. They were publicly defamed and smeared by the mainstream media and the radical left as "insurrectionists" and "terrorists.”

**In many ways, that’s when the hardest part began — financial ruin, ongoing stigma, and now fresh attacks from radicals like Jamie Raskin.**

After everything our fellow patriots have endured, they shouldn’t have to face this alone.

The courtroom fight continues with a razor-sharp deadline.

Without your rapid support, these individuals won’t have the legal resources they need to push back effectively.

[Your donation today provides emergency legal defense funding so we can keep standing strong for them.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2g9kilno6ldk91pjsa56h9lqaa0ql7i45et9gkg_rp22sh2s8i6epr3c3hmcpr4c5h2bs)

## Trump Extends Iran Ceasefire
President Trump on Tuesday [extended the ceasefire with Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL_GdKBl7QOucJGG7tKmRIu9PjYy5mScI_f3ESnyA-lGGumN5n3cphtJlHR_p5VtCduU-Ngjl8J5ckw7B8nM34WTZ0_ipLwoTQjY1WBqxMmTxNdkKm8DM7Ku2LZ93w0XNHipFgsutAjadV7PRFob6i4muBl51gNesRJ70sAgtgA96AY68i1cteuD6YaBlQH2UrbcfG6SysIhvrYn58ZtaxXtUspjV_pN4ahwPI6jcWl2Z6lwPNEKRzBnbhWOJX-tj1oypfqgXP9dbJayxipb_zgkRtm7Xhm4ryTxd6b8y83T4k8AAAD__yKudmU) indefinitely, reversing his earlier statement that he planned to resume bombing when the two-week truce expired Wednesday evening. The open-ended extension came at the request of Pakistani mediators and after Vice President JD Vance [scrapped his planned trip](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2SqzAMx09jOmeMMIYULl5Dl9duyThYBO06dsZWYLn9jvcK20mj0e__8XGbb44Cxcd_90TLa5ojHiUgM-Z5QVdwpYz4zRg9ekcL8eniDAqMVFoCzN5ROGfdeLsiAnYN2nYYzNiDhr7Z7Gj6K5quX67j2Bq11s2NSikDRrf3tiFbaUoDtEoNqrso43yrrt0yrNqMIwqt0BOnfPlMFHnDNZxpx3xZ0rMJdmN-FdH9EzAJmOL5SoXrScBUwQImpevcCpjeRdZ8AqbdxQWly5l2LNKxPDZilFt6F5SuSJ_edy7ykdMhq1j9k5RdlOzCVyU02frXQSFQMYPQ6vF0FH498Z-K3C38BAAA__8zkoWU) to Islamabad for a second round of peace talks because Iran refused to send negotiators. Trump said Iran's government is "seriously fractured" and ordered the U.S. military to maintain its [naval blockade of Iranian ports](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuwyAURb8Gb7aeHxicgaGLt3TtaBF4Tl6FIcI0Tv6-cob-QLcrXelcnft1ns-OI6frp1vJ1iXPifYtUq1UZk9uo4UL0bNSChQce64vl2YE1C2oFnEOjuNrVk2wCxGSbMj2xuhxQIVDc7MktfFyGNxgQF5g9Poy9JLoBNpJ8H3D9qCBQuwBDMgOtAs9nKQ3i9LjSEIBBa65dN-ZU73REl_5QaXzeW2ivdV634T8EDgJnPZ979yT83a0AqeDLXACdeRe4FTLz3pvubjU7q60f47tW3LjnJpiw33nGHnTRii4ro7je6z-66GHxd8AAAD__62reJU) while awaiting a "unified proposal" from Tehran. Iran's civilian leaders have reportedly favored continued diplomacy, while Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps commanders [oppose concessions and reject talks](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp8GOiMzmJ8ULrahy7ZbogGPk9kYg-whbN5-xS3uC9z6k46-c_7cpzty4Pj4jStZ8dsU6cyBRChNC2Emz4non1B05JAXlg_GCTR0ShsFMDnk8JlM6awnAmpKsnXfd0MLBtryabthdv3sW1_PAzjob1DPt9kvs281GdAl24umDUCtda-bSnfoan1rlt6bbhioMJocy5aqvxtHeZIPn-1NqVq2tQz2KbLnovlVwFjAeJ5ntcz5srj2AsbAb1LH7lAoFzAeWXHCqE5MStKx7upbU-344iwY1U64kBIMr6yOILyiHBerTNbtJ4fAuesLox8rcvj6IT-K97bwPwAA__-kBoXy) as long as the blockade holds.
## Virginia Voters Approve Redistricting
Virginia voters on Tuesday narrowly approved a referendum to [redraw the state's congressional map](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuwyAUhp8Gb7bggC8MDF28pWtHi8BxcioMFtC4fvvKeYXOn_Rfvq_bcrMUKD4-7YamrmmJeJSAtWJeHNqCK2XE34rRo7fkqJ42LsBhaLlqARZvKZyLarxZEQFlg0aM4zD1oKBvnkY5EGoaeI9y8kLgqGTvdC-1Fl5rrRsyVxpXAILzkcuOD9YLrqUbVzVMEzLF0VNNuftOFOsT13CmF-bOpa0J5lnrXpj8YDAzmI_j6OLdXS8uzmDeU6BKrjCY37PLjo5saDGgq5TiBV6UHxTJtncbQqrthrb8ZCxNNn4_KAQqw8gUf2yWwru3_kvWy8BfAAAA__-IDn4B) in Democrats' favor, a result that could flip as many as four additional House seats to the party ahead of the November midterms. The measure passed 50.8% to 49.2%. The proposed maps give Democrats an advantage in 10 of the state's 11 districts, up from the six they currently hold under maps drawn by a bipartisan commission. More than 2.7 million votes were cast, nearly matching the early-vote total from last fall's statewide races. Outside groups [poured millions into](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOmzAURb8GNiPnYewweOjClq4dkeP3gNcaO7IdCH9fpb_Q-UpX55xfj_nhOHBcf7qdbF3SHOksgWqlPHtyhRbORJ9KEQkde66XizNI0EIqATCj43DNqkW7EAH1LdmbMfo-gIKh3Sw8x76XYAanBtTgURs5mhH0U-teybFl-32TCuAmpZF9J7XDmxx7bxal73dqlCTkmnL3O3GsGy3hSgflzqe9DXar9VWa_kcDUwPTeZ7dkj5fi-_ewPRKgSv70sCELv8Re4p0iSWkhEUcnFeO7ITbyKHIhFxqZl85ruJIlYRP74BicxEF0p58drWILb0LCcKV2mzxdXIIXLRplFx3x-EfWf2vnIeFvwEAAP__HSiL-w) both sides of the fight.
## Egypt Unveils $27B AI-Powered City
Egypt launched a $27 billion development east of Cairo called "The Spine," a three-mile, car-free urban corridor billed as the [first AI-powered "cognitive city"](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O2zAQRk9DdTSoEfWTQoUXgbpNkyKlMBY_yZPQpEDRZnz7QLnCVlM8YPC99-tz_mTxErYf_MCY1zgHlMMjZ6R5AR9YJQF_M4KDY1kkvznMZKjTxmqi2bH492wrN64Aoakw1n3fDS1Zaqv7aAdbt0S3uuWh5a5uDGO4mRZYCB36Ssbzm7FEtTG9aS6mY1ebb83Sr7YbBihr4CTHdPkdJeQ7Vv-OL6TLEh-VH-8574dqroomRVMp5fI4wskUTQj6eSiaTqkTxuTdee-cdY76T4hF8y0-s8b23rM-dEDRLHqPBQlOL3ELkuUFfZrrAE56YUlR0cRJX69U7x-bV80UF3Gq-f5xtkQ5fiLtVRrdXsR7ObpeWbM9WPz_1flLqV8j_QsAAP__FK6TyA) in the Middle East. The project features 165 towers, 3,500 hotel rooms, and a fully underground logistics network, which developers say is the world's first. [Explore the renderings here.](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykjzFvgzAQRn8NbImOw2B38NAlW7p2tFz8OVxlTASnpPz7Kv0LnZ_ek97nNVyjFKm3j7jAa15DxXMvUMUWJsQdWTbgR1ETUpRJ9Ig1MPF4InNiDilKOYJpk88Ao2_hO2tHN7DhoZ29SQbAMMS-z8OU4ZwDUgSR7Vz-Qiv-VSPD3BFZ6s80xtTRWz_ZbEbn0BhCEl238_cqVWfkcqwPbOdpXdriZ9X73vTvDV8avuiM_S4VutxevOFLu_l0f0opso-2MXRbopQ_V_81_PD8GwAA__8O6Gok) The development spans roughly 600 acres and includes residential, office, retail, and entertainment space connected by a tram network and driverless transit, with no traditional cars allowed. A centralized AI system will manage energy, water, security, and mobility across the entire district. Developers say the project is expected to [create 55,000 direct jobs](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuqzAYxfGnMVuQ-TA2GTzchS137YiMfUi-ytgRdkN5-yp9he5HP-n8P27zzXHkdP_vNti65jnhKBG1Yp89XMHKO_BdkQKCY8_1dGkmSfoi1YVoDo7jOasm2BUg9A1sZ4weB1I0NA-L3i9hwECL6pWnMHaGlqvvTQcoqalh-9akIuqkNLJvpXahk9fem1XpcYRQEoFr3tvPzKk-sMYzv7C3Pm9NtI9an0X0_wRNgqbjOFq3u-V94z0QNKUcIGgiraTSJGhavgonlHKBzylvZ7Pb8Dw4Ri7aCCXvm-P4q9c_JXlZ-gkAAP__jZl0OA) and generate roughly $16 billion in tax revenue over time. Construction is underway, with the first phase set to open in 2027 and full completion planned for 2030.

## Burrows Targets Online Gaming Violence
Texas House Speaker Dustin Burrows has tasked members with investigating online gaming platforms after a simulation of the 2022 Uvalde school shooting was [discovered](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OhCAUhZ8GOyaAiGNBsY3dbLulucJVSa4yAcaft9-4r7D1OTk_389reEGgsM3fsKIt5xSHDY9MWAqmwUXyDjJCSpjLDPlAIjzfNCihDBeaKzV4CHQNuvJ2FL6TFVrZtubZNG2nq8ViMxoBT2WwabRQoutMLZXr6qeWzdR2VbB3mNBKSSlqWT9862TTTsL7ujZmFEwL9KHE9CgLFjwhT3TFHdPDxbUiu5Tyzqz-Yqpnqndjhk8uYbtVpvr7DlM9RQfEVD9-UopH5jF5TJkn3AMePE48xZHiyd0SyPMME5aLw1QwcR-yu-uu2_bZgTzyvMRYwjbzGVaskvXvIxCFbFqmxbxCoL9x5X9Id6t-AwAA__8Ux44f) on Roblox, an online gaming platform popular among children, where users can design and play their own games. "_Turning an unspeakable act of violence, whose scars remain across the Uvalde community, into entertainment is a profound moral failure_ ," [said Burrows](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCngQ5k1hhD4eIaulx7JTL2AtZtMLI3QN7-V_IKfzfSSJ9G8-8xPWygsK9_7RMN30ucdrwyITOmyUXyzma0KWHm1eYLifA-aAIBXSXaCmDyNtB7aktvZuGHpkTTaN31SumhLTfjO-iVlmqRfpCi1-CUnUHNQyvE4qwog_lgogVoGiEbWXvtGqUX4b2UXTeLohXoA8dU84aMt80LveOJqXbxWZLZmI9cyD8FjAWM13XVbktx_7QFjO5F_EpYwGgTB0ef9EWqHNH-x1SlOFO8q7CfmDmsHOJevU5LHisAaPQg-vrYjjIZf1yBKOROF61YnzbQdwL_7rjTwE8AAAD__yF1g34). State Rep. Don McLaughlin (R-Uvalde) agreed. "_Turning the murder of innocent children and teachers into virtual content is beyond sick_ ," he said. Burrows asked lawmakers to [evaluate](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGyozAMhk9jOmdsYfBLQbEN3dt2S0ZgBTwxmLFEyLv9DtkjbCeN9Enz_X--h2-MKW7zb1ypk_cjDxudnEiEyjDlFCZkwlKIZUY-KSV672kAA602TgMMAWP6GVwVutGEu62os963X03j765aOvKN9dPdj-PXaMlh09gAzvkm3L03NVWxu44ZB2CtqW19C36yjX-YEOq6bUejnKEQJZebLCT0Rn6kn_yicpvyWqVuEdlZ1b8U9Ar68zxvT0a5hgr6y0ZB_8EU9NcrBb1xn1pBzzvhk4oOB0vc9HiUkk_WyE_WH0gv-WDSknXcXsQSZxTSJY8pv3XcdCHe8_ZvY8aVNMf1SChxm_XxwhRI85Lz1Svoq9KF_YwpRW69cmZeMaaPh_xf-q8O_gYAAP__INKcIg) gaming sites' safety features, explore age verification and parental consent requirements for such platforms, assess developers' liability for exploiting children, and examine the extent to which federal laws shield platforms from litigation. In a statement, Roblox Chief Safety Officer Matt Kaufman said the simulation was taken down and that the user who uploaded it was banned, adding that certain platform features are restricted based on users' ages. "_Violent extremism and depictions of sensitive real-world events are against our policies_ ," [he said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2ypSAQhJ8GM07BiH-BwSZkd9MNLYRRqR0dC7jH49tveV9ho5mgq7u_6j9f05eLFI_1t9txLJ-FpwOvTFgKpskzBe8yupQwl9XlC4nwc9IEClqpjASYgot0T6YK46zCoCscdde1fdN0g6m2sQ-z8r7t0S39ULcaBzU0pllCD1AH46s4PmbKAGital2_Qud10y0qhLpu21kJozDEwulVNiz4cXmhm9-YXp73isatlDOL-pcAK8Be1_X6zq5wcPcjEGBz4XQLsA_Zc1yJfAiwT64Aq8zzawH2--0ooPRM3_scD5SnS3_JHUFmvzGTzBtziccqV7ej5EMmnok_8ky8nyVLv0UKMrsFyy0TviNeckm8y5_aAmw_dLptBq1UJ8BWaQznFYlibjth1Lq7SD9U5f-2eI_wLwAA__-ByZ8M).
## Woman Arrested for Husband's 2002 Murder
A 55-year-old woman was [arrested](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU9jsmqZwsB04GATstl0Q2S7CmzJ4JZtoPv2K-YKk5VU0vv__X_f87cJMezrX7Oxru8lzTtfJXKtnGeXIjlT2OTMpa6mXBwjv19xRokDSAWIM5kQP7NqSFtJz7Zh3Y7j8NX341M1XlPPTillJVppeXwaJ59LP_T912g715om6BsmFWLbyq7tHjS6th8XSdR1w2ClUJIp1JQf1XPltylL_KST88OlrYna1_oqovsjcBI47Z9XKvV-CZxussBJqvtuBU5HgdtP4HSFhcF5k1cmuEL14I9izU4FUEqE2x1uediOTJwh7PATDmYnIHOsvnIGyyEGPrlA9ZwZTGbYUmYI-5niySRwarKm1xViDGUYhZLrZkL8KV9_N_mp8X8AAAD__95elrI) in Waxahachie on Monday for the alleged murder of her husband in 2002. Frank Weiss, then 57, was found with gunshot wounds to the chest near Lake Lewisville in Frisco. Police [used](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OszAQxJ8GOqNlbf64cPE16fK1VyLHuwRLBiPbCeTtT9w9wnUjzWhGv_m6T3frg9-e_-3KppxznDY-cuBSOE0uBnI2s02Jc3nafHAIfO5hQsBegBKIE1kfPpOqyTyAdFuzaYehH7tu0KpeDMjOEXROg0KF1OlxVFprieM8kuyx9uYqA4XYtiBb2dDg2m6YgUjKvn9ApYDJl5iasnDh0-Y5fOKbU-PiWgezlLLnSv6r8Fbh7TiOZo6nujCuQIW3S15OXO0mflmYBAKgWF-JOInllR92IzEnn12sk6H98CH43A-VgudqffgZK3-76G3wOwAA__9xNXsQ) "advancements in investigative techniques, modern technology, along with new information from a key witness" to obtain a warrant to arrest Lisa Honrud, his wife at the time. "_For 24 years, the Weiss family has waited for answers_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAQhJ8GOtCyNvZP4eJv6HLtlWjBS7C04MhYcfL2J3KPcN1II32jb75v042ChOP-RTu7_FrjdHA5hXPmNC1R_EInU0p85judhUX49ZAJAU0DukGcPAV5T7r2bgY_dDW7zlrzr-_toOvNGUBYrDcEerZ2UN6wUaTXAYmVmoc6uAsGGrHrQHWq9XbperuC90oZM0OlgX3IMbV548wvOld5xyendol7LW7L-XFW6n-FY4VjKaV90xbj1VY4XjoVjpRyWISveMSUt-YDakrc6Wh-_dg3qJtOQ68BFLRb3qVOzj9KEAmnsZWG-05BPrv5b289Hf4EAAD__yAnfl0) Frisco Police Chief David Shilson. "_Today's arrest is an important step toward justice, and we will continue working until everyone involved is held accountable_." "_I dreamed of there being an answer, but I didn't expect one_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb_G7ohgjGFdUGyTLttuaY09g0FLggUkTv5-5fc-4dVXujrn_L3NN4wpPrY_eGfX3j7PDz5q4ta4zGtOtGJlLIVr27AenBK_9zSDBCOkFgAzYUyfWffkFkmT6tkpa82vcbST7oMjs-AwLoO3I6NGMMariSYpxwm01Wsf3XkmNYBSclDDheyqRusl0TAYs8hOS6bYcrm0wI3fWH365BeXy5rvfXKhtb12w-8Orh1cd8574nPq4HpEz-KbnkmAFh_GUgX6xkWEZ13wQYIYWxCnqzhlxVIY_7VQ8nMLQqlp1AZsXxztR0wpVmM7Lbc7xvQF0H6W7eXgfwAAAP__Ej2CYQ) Carla Weiss, the victim's 44-year-old daughter. She told a local news outlet she doesn't believe Honrud acted alone.
## Texas Pushes Ahead on Psychedelic Research
The state of Texas is investing $50 million into research on the effectiveness of psychedelics like ibogaine for [treating](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGSnDAMhp_GdNoxthd2C4o0dJc2JSNsAZpobcb2HcvbZ7hMniCt_pG--fT_-pg-kIXj-hNfNNT3kqZIRxGqlfLkkwSPhTBnKnXFcpAIvXeZjDYdaAfGTAFZzsk1YZh1eLYNDW3fd4_7vX-6ZhueDv3cWhec10jB-wf1D0_aaZzt3WHDw3VMO2PaVtvW3kLv23u_6BCs7bpZK6cpcE35Vjeq9MayyJm-KN98ejUybLXuRdkfyozKjMdx3H4XrFeozHjZKDN-rykzXihlRm2VGW37L4CDRUDwM_oNuBZIRwQvHNmjQM2MUoBjTcBzWpEjwV5Ov1EgYQ-4VMqw_H0k1AQLxwAIIX-u4NNrx3he441kV2Zs8hD2i8il65XT6wtZvl3q_zXwNZg_AQAA__9L0Z1n) traumatic brain injuries and addiction. UT Health Houston and UT Medical Branch in Galveston are leading the effort. The funding was [authorized last year](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULuOhDAQ-5rQsUqGR6BIcQ3dXnslGsjARhoISmZ32b8_cb9wjWXJli375z7eMXDY12_cyMm5xHGnd2YSoTTOkf2MmTAlyrJifhMznQePoKEtdV0CjB4Df8a68G7SvjcFOWNt2zWN7evi4Wxnl6bvlw4mQ3NVE_reT1RBC2ZB9EVwV5iuAYzRlalu3s6msYv2vqradtKq1uSDxHSTBwmdmBf-xBel2xy3gt1D5Miq-lIwKBjyQbOk58ZxRr62XC4Fg5wKBnxmCbuC4RIUDKChUTDo7oKLhSmuGHYql5jKFwkl3HNZJOePd2AOubWq1uuGgf_a5X-fvRz8BgAA__-Pt4Cg) by legislation establishing a consortium of universities, hospitals, and drug companies to develop a psychedelic therapeutic that could obtain FDA approval. The bill requires a participating drug developer to match the state's $50 million investment and agree to share future profits with Texas. Last month, Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick and House Speaker Dustin Burrows announced the program would [move forward](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2ypCAUhJ9GMyzAHzQg2MRsNt3QOnIOSi2iBTjq29-aeYWbd3f19_17TS9w3oXlL2yk8233KdCVPOVMcTK7RwOJIEZKeYF0kfd0H36SXHaMN0zKCcH5Z2pK1DPHQZSkhVJd37ZqaMpVQ9-1WKO1M9l5EIOyhpu2b3sUygLvSqc_Y7yRUghei7pCZUSrLEes666bedFwQpf3WOWVMt2QrH_2N8XK7Fvp9ZrzkYr6TyHHQo7XdVV2vxWcKbvwiRRy_DAVcvyWmYczmJW5gHRQQAqZHekxKyF5Z1jKJz4MbKbIMJ4LM_t2QHCU2OZSYhvE_2XUeFzOe5c6VTR82cD57538O4lvLX8CAAD__46siu4), even though none of the pharmaceutical companies' proposals were approved. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

"That Hansel is so hot right now." \- Mugatu in Zoolander
That was one of my favorite movies coming up. I later got to meet Ben Stiller, who shot me a 'Blue Steel' tweet during one of my campaigns. It was a highlight.
A little more than eight years ago, I started running for President in February of 2018. My campaign was announced with a NYTimes article called, "The Robots are Coming."
No one cared.
I shouldn't have been surprised. I only later learned that trying to get someone's attention about a presidential race almost 36 months ahead of the general election was something of a fool's errand. Just about all of the other candidates would declare after the midterms that November. There's an ebb and flow to these things, and energy around the presidential only started running hot in mid-2019 when televised debates hit the airwaves.
In my case, the 12 months or so to have the field to myself were a godsend. I got to get comfortable campaigning, hone the message, build a little bit of a following and get my feet under me. Heck, in my case the biggest thing was getting added to the polls at all, which required me stumping around Iowa and New Hampshire for months in order to register.
Thank you if you were a part of that campaign. I was anonymous when it launched and together we mainstreamed a number of ideas that are all the more relevant today.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/da138265-38a5-4c67-82f5-533919d9a3d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The energy maxed out in 2020 when the voting started. There were crowds everywhere I went, and my job was to rev them up. I compared it to holding a live wire, where you're channeling a movement and trying to grow it.
My day-to-day was a barometer for how we were doing. People recognize you on the street and give you a thumbs up? That's a great sign. I would see MATH hats in the wild routinely. You could actually feel for yourself what was happening in real-time.
It's hard to believe that six years have passed. The past six years have been busy. I wrote a book or two, started a company and kicked off a political party. But not much compares with the electricity of a presidential campaign. My wife Evelyn recently pulled up a video of me saying "Chant my name!" in jest to a crowd of hundreds at a rally in Washington D.C.
I'm not someone who chases the energy in that way - I'm not naturally an extrovert or an adrenaline junkie. My idea of a great time is reading and writing, or spending time with my family. I didn't run in 2020 to gain notoriety, but instead to advance solutions I believed would be necessary.
Lately, I've felt the energy around me picking up again.
Maybe it's because AI is on everyone's minds. Maybe it's because several of my takes - AI eating the jobs, the need for UBI, the polarization of the two-party system, Joe Biden needing a primary - have aged well. Maybe it's because more and more people are waking up to the deteriorating state of our institutions.
A friend over dinner complimented me the other night and said, "Somehow, you've managed to stay relevant pretty much the whole time since 2020."
It was a nice sentiment, though I'm not sure he's completely right. Sometimes it's something you do, and sometimes the wave comes to you. When it comes, you do all you can to ride it.

**[Donate NOW to become a launch day donor and supporter of our people-powered campaign!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsFlYb8tSgv_iNH9eUO8IibbLOfX6PT-3gGyMq8W09rTfTVdCpsioUL_iS_P244ONuq183eCQUFgG-E12F1IDQNStPcWljzFEwPMYkF8KmhAuPSvx85DtrPIpOmSmamZcpt5zgncv7Ciin9Pe0hcoqRG3mrWcnwyH2p4lAVAJJCjPseMol7UOcrWQ_cpkUTjweomVmJUVJC6uXyjgEkkIyZbvFWZwcPNsfGpdmOr5krifH6pcAcfGk3U6TtxRZVyE3XMwXRnNnoheTez4NMguJyfRAUC8W_pLVk19nrvvx99tVvY5My7mtGndF3cHFVNdc/4q0/gBDnG1hRSNKjapO-bxjTuw/h1/h001.tNxyd8gAwXxXXEDRptPuAHP5s_D_wpJJDe9XhGmfdsc)

* * *
I came to this country with just a few hundred dollars in my pocket and a whole lot of determination.
I worked three minimum wage jobs at the same time to support my family and put myself through school. I know what it means to struggle. I know what it means to fight for every inch.
That’s why I became a social worker. That’s why I became a union member. And that’s why I’ve spent my life fighting for working people.
In 2017, I made history as one of the first immigrant Latinas elected to the Virginia House of Delegates.
And I didn’t get there with big money. I got there because people like you believed in something better.
Together, we raised wages. We expanded workers’ rights. We protected reproductive freedom. We proved that when working people organize, we win. **
** **Now, I’m stepping up to run for Congress in this must-win red to blue district — because Washington isn’t working for us, and we MUST flip the House in November.**
****It’s working for billionaires, for corporations, for the same special interests that have rigged the system against working families for decades.
I’m running to change that. To build an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top. To protect our rights and our dignity. To make sure no family has to struggle the way mine did just to get by.
But if we’re going to win this race, if we’re going to take on the corporate money and the political establishment, and the same old Democrats, we need to build something powerful from day one.
_That means you._

clean_body: | | | — My name is Elizabeth Guzman. I’m a proud union member, working mom, member of the Virginia House of Delegates, and today, I’m launching my campaign for Congress. And I’m doing it differently. I’m not taking a dime from corporations, PACs, or special interests. This campaign belongs to working people — and it starts with you. I came to this country with just a few hundred dollars in my pocket and a whole lot of determination. I worked three minimum wage jobs at the same time to support my family and put myself through school. I know what it means to struggle. I know what it means to fight for every inch. That’s why I became a social worker. That’s why I became a union member. And that’s why I’ve spent my life fighting for working people. In 2017, I made history as one of the first immigrant Latinas elected to the Virginia House of Delegates. And I didn’t get there with big money. I got there because people like you believed in something better. Together, we raised wages. We expanded workers’ rights. We protected reproductive freedom. We proved that when working people organize, we win. Now, I’m stepping up to run for Congress in this must-win red to blue district — because Washington isn’t working for us, and we MUST flip the House in November. It’s working for billionaires, for corporations, for the same special interests that have rigged the system against working families for decades. I’m running to change that. To build an economy that works for everyone, not just those at the top. To protect our rights and our dignity. To make sure no family has to struggle the way mine did just to get by. But if we’re going to win this race, if we’re going to take on the corporate money and the political establishment, and the same old Democrats, we need to build something powerful from day one. That means you. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. No PAC money. No corporate checks. Just us. That is how much a GOP super PAC just pledged to spend to defeat me in North Carolina.
The New York Times reports Republicans are targeting our state with record-breaking spending because they are terrified of losing their grip on the Senate. They’re counting on dark money to drown out our message.
I’ve spent my life fighting for North Carolinians, but I can’t out-organize a $71 million barrage of attack ads alone. Our grassroots movement is the only thing standing in their way.

Virginia voters just dealt a significant blow to MAGA's gerrymandering in Texas and other red states. In fact, it gives Democrats an edge over MAGA for the upcoming midterms:

But while all eyes were on Virginia, another battle was already brewing.
On May 19, Georgia holds a state Supreme Court election.
This election is another crucial front in the battle against Trump and MAGA's election rigging schemes. If Democrats win this race, it will set them up to completely flip the GA Supreme Court just months before the 2028 election.
You remember 2020. Georgia was ground zero for Trump's election rigging plot. Fake electors. Pressure campaigns. Direct attempts to manipulate the vote.
Georgia's Supreme Court is the last line of defense against the voting restrictions, rigged maps, and legal challenges MAGA will throw at the state in the 2028 presidential election.

---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rgkD5twD_NICr0JZqceJPDKMnqWuFHnBI-f1TwL9ybLviaGmvyHtK2piD1b9aqO_7sBCu6FzP2ojoGy0kmnWezsJf4nszOBibJV35eZDZ1lhEwQn0UcY8LycF6rvONOe6VKMT6DswnvS58m_643t0i4QfAmqY58tx3qVC7n9hHVZay9x26WxzLjrqwosm1S9CtinShsRSqWvhmzP8Rlf9QXxACccNNrPFr6ee8KkAmU=&c=Wva7h7xDg1QXlqx5Img2N3IMuSQFxKNsp17Wjk-yOaCyvHwyz6cBMA==&ch=5-zDYOOS354Up0Pk2qI1ISKMAGYD0K0k1NcH2RzLyMcFJYf77vqY2g==)

This race will be decided by which side is able to reach more voters. And right now, that's the problem.
There is a funding gap on our side, and if we don't close it, we could lose.
That's why Defend Our Courts is rallying Democrats to come to Georgia's aid. With the support of over 100,000 Democrats nationwide, we have already helped dems win massive victories in the Wisconsin and Pennsylvania Supreme Court races.
Now we're taking our winning formula to Georgia where Dems have an opportunity to deal another blow to Trump's election rigging schemes.
But time is running out. This election is in 27 days, and we have to raise enough money to reach more voters than MAGA before the clock runs out. That's why we're asking you today:

Friend,

No one likes asking for help. Most of us have worked hard all our lives to be self-sufficient and provide for our families.

But for our January 6 patriots still waiting on pardons — good individuals who answered the call to peacefully protest a stolen election — the last five-plus years have been nothing short of a nightmare.

Luckily, **the Trump Department of Justice has rightly asked the court to vacate the charges and convictions against the unpardoned Proud Boys and Oath Keepers leaders** and dismiss the cases with prejudice.

After years of weaponized prosecutions under the Biden regime, this is the right step toward real justice.

**But a new threat has emerged — not from the DOJ, but from the radical left in Congress.**

Congressman Jamie Raskin — one of the most partisan Democrats in Washington — filed an amicus brief in three separate appeals in the D.C. Circuit to defend the original jury verdicts.

**Our side’s attorneys had to drop everything and work around the clock all weekend to draft a strong opposition brief! **

The filing deadline is extremely tight — early this week.

These patriots have been completely financially drained after more than five years of brutal legal battles, imprisonment, and persecution. Many are veterans who served our country honorably, only to be treated like enemies of the state by their own government. They simply do not have the resources to fund this critical fight on their own while still dealing with other lingering issues.

**Stand in the Gap has stepped in to raise emergency funds so their legal team can file a powerful response — on time and with strength.**

That is why we need your help today, Friend.

Protecting our democracy means protecting Earth

---

Fifteen months. That’s all it took. Peter, since Donald Trump returned to office, he has:
* **Pulled out of the Paris Climate Accord** — again — abandoning the global commitments that protect our air, water, and future.
* **Gutted the Forest Service** , stripping the very programs designed to prevent catastrophic wildfires — right before wildfire season.
* **Opened protected lands to drilling** , reversing decades of environmental protection actions in a single stroke.
* **Repealed the legal basis for all federal greenhouse gas regulation** — wiping out the foundation for clean air rules covering cars, power plants, and oil fields.
* **Proposed slashing the EPA’s budget by more than half** — which would gut its ability to protect the air we breathe and the water our families drink.

But Trump’s environmental destruction doesn’t exist in a vacuum. It’s propped up by Republican-drawn legislative maps that lock extremists into power: Unaccountable legislatures kill clean energy bills and weaken clean water and clean air initiatives. Anti-democracy judges rubber-stamp those rollbacks. Gerrymandered districts silence voters. **To restore our environmental stewardship — and prevent Trump from causing further destruction during the rest of his administration — we need to preserve our democracy.[This Earth Day, make a gift to battle extreme Republican gerrymanders and voter suppression tactics nationally and locally.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129937442/616075989/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_EarthDay_email_20260422-NDRC-Tier1-EarthDay_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260422-NDRC-Tier1-EarthDay_&utm_campaign=EarthDay&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdjMDMxMWU0LTUyM2UtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=8L28UvCTDWTfz1CTgCyi884kj-IbLB0MxEhSA06sfKE=)** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

clean_body: Protecting our democracy means protecting Earth | Fifteen months. That’s all it took. Peter, since Donald Trump returned to office, he has: Pulled out of the Paris Climate Accord — again — abandoning the global commitments that protect our air, water, and future. Gutted the Forest Service , stripping the very programs designed to prevent catastrophic wildfires — right before wildfire season. Opened protected lands to drilling , reversing decades of environmental protection actions in a single stroke. Repealed the legal basis for all federal greenhouse gas regulation — wiping out the foundation for clean air rules covering cars, power plants, and oil fields. Proposed slashing the EPA’s budget by more than half — which would gut its ability to protect the air we breathe and the water our families drink. But Trump’s environmental destruction doesn’t exist in a vacuum. It’s propped up by Republican-drawn legislative maps that lock extremists into power: Unaccountable legislatures kill clean energy bills and weaken clean water and clean air initiatives. Anti-democracy judges rubber-stamp those rollbacks. Gerrymandered districts silence voters. Ron Bailey grew up in Leominster, MA -- a small town outside of Boston. He met his wife Joanne in Iowa while performing with the rock band, "The Je-Ron's." He got married and spent the next 25 years in the Insurance Industry before having a supernatural visitation from Jesus that changed his life forever. He retired to Florida at the age of 42 and now lives in Franklin, TN with his wife, children and grandchildren.

One man's journey into the supernatural with God!
A GLIMPSE BEHIND HEAVEN'S VEIL is Ron's first book.

Millions of students, activists, and folks from all over took action to celebrate and protect our environment. But decades later, the climate crisis is taking a toll on our public lands, our crops, and our health. Colorado is no stranger to the challenges this brings — from wildfires and floods to droughts and record-breaking heat. That’s why we’ve worked hard to tackle climate change head-on. We wrote the _Inflation Reduction Act,_ our country’s boldest climate change legislation to date. We secured billions to address what is beginning to look like the worst drought in history in the West and protect communities from wildfires. We passed the _RECHARGE Act,_ which helps boost our transition to clean transportation and makes it cheaper to drive an electric vehicle. Don’t get me wrong, there’s still plenty more work to do. But for every step forward, President Trump and his MAGA cronies are cancelling billions of dollars in programs that address climate change. We’ve got to fight back. We already stopped their sell-off of our public lands and are challenging their attempts to cancel clean energy projects and attack weather science. **_[So today, if you’re able, we’re asking you to chip in a few bucks to help us keep working to confront the climate crisis. Long before I was a congressional candidate or a scientist, I was a kid growing up in the Texas Hill Country. From a young age, my dad instilled in me a love of nature and wild lands, which is at the root of my desire to preserve and protect them.

[_**And that’s why, this Earth Day, I’m asking you to chip in $10 or whatever you can to protect the natural beauty of Texas and a healthy environment with clean air and water.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129942652/616092094/-1456264782?amount=10&refcode=KH_ATA_EM_FR_EarthDay_260422_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NjQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjA4ODE0YzItNTgzZS1mMTExLThlZjItMDAwZDNhMTRiNjQwIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=velOz2BnmOB5f1Ie6v5EWDW_yo4L4y7eLRTdq0vsG4M=)

I pursued my PhD in animal behavior because the natural world fascinated me, and because I believed, and still believe, that science can solve the biggest challenges we face. The climate crisis is one of those challenges.

**Here in TX-21, we are on the front lines.** We've watched historic drought dry out our rivers. We've watched triple-digit heat waves stretch longer every summer. And last summer, the floods in Kerr County devastated families, homes, and entire communities.

Our district sits in one of the fastest-developing regions in Texas, which is straining our precious water resources. **The longer we wait, the more expensive – and painful – the solutions become.**

As your next Congresswoman, I will bring the same rigor I brought to my research, and to my oversight work at the Government Accountability Office, to fight for our planet and natural resources.

That means:
* funding the federal agencies and scientists who protect us from climate disaster,

* investing in modern water infrastructure and drought resilience,

* holding polluters accountable,

* advancing clean energy alternatives, and

* conserving the public lands and wild spaces my dad taught me to love.

**But none of this happens without a grassroots campaign strong enough to flip this seat!**

We see it everywhere: in the air that’s harder to breathe, in the water we’re told is safe but isn’t, and in the rising cancer and disease rates in communities that have been treated as disposable for far too long.

→ Since JanePAC started this work, we’ve elected **over 200 brave leaders** who will stand up to Big Oil and Big Polluters.

# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2184%2E791427%2EOodNNT)

Friend — **I am a refugee.**
That’s not something I shy away from. Being a refugee has made me who I am today.
I fled a brutal civil war in Somalia, which is why I understand that diplomacy and peace must always be sought over death and destruction.
I lived in a refugee camp for years, which is why I can stand tough against the insults and abuse that Trump and Republicans constantly throw my way.
I was given an opportunity for a new start in America, which is why I fight for a common sense immigration system that allows people to come here safely and legally.
My family and I worked hard to afford to live in our new home, which is why I believe in the dignity of the working class and the need for higher wages, healthcare, housing, and education for all.
In 2024, over 100,000 refugees were resettled in America. Trump has now capped that number at just 7,500 a year as part of his extremist immigration regime.
As we keep up the fight to abolish ICE, close down Trump’s mass detention camps, and reunite families and communities who have been ripped apart, it’s important to remember that we must also fight to live up to America’s promise, inscribed on the Statue of Liberty:
**_"Give me your tired, your poor,
Your huddled masses yearning to breathe free”_**
We shouldn’t let fascists like Trump make us afraid of immigrants; we should welcome them. We shouldn’t see immigrants as a problem to deal with; we should talk about the amazing contributions that refugees and all immigrants add to our great nation.
[**If you’re with me in the fight for a better way forward for America’s immigration system, chip in whatever you can afford to my campaign. I’m proud to be a refugee and eternally grateful for everything America has given me, which is why I’m fighting to give back to my nation and better the lives of all Americans, no matter where they were born.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-apr26.yEIO3a&refcode=em260422-1-180&t=3&akid=2184%2E791427%2EOodNNT)

name: Team Freedom Va
subject: It's Official!
body:
Paid Family & Medical Leave is law in Virginia
| | |
---
| |
---
| It's Official!
---
| Friends-
Today, Paid Family & Medical Leave became law in Virginia!
---
| |
---
Paid Family and Medical Leave will ensure that Virginians can take up to 12 weeks of paid leave each year when they need it, such as when a new baby arrives or to recover from a serious illness or injury. Virginians will be eligible for Paid Family and Medical Leave after 120 days of employment. It will provide four weeks of safe leave for survivors of domestic violence, harassment, sexual assault, and stalking. It will also expand the definition of family to include extended relatives and "chosen" family. Finally, Virginians who use Paid Family and Medical Leave will receive 80% wage replacement and protection of their health care coverage for the duration of their leave.
"This is a life-changing policy for over 3 million workers who are used to making impossible choices to care for their families. With Paid Family and Medical Leave, no one will have to choose between caring for themselves or their loved ones and collecting a necessary paycheck again. Thank you first to the patrons Senator Boysko and Delegate Sewell, who have fought hard to make this a reality. We'd also like to thank the Virginians who fought hard for Paid Family and Medical Leave alongside the patrons. This win would not be possible without their stories and their sacrifice. A final thank you to Governor Spanberger, who championed this policy from day one of her campaign and, together with the General Assembly, delivered for Virginia families. While today closes an important chapter for Paid Family and Medical Leave, it is not over yet, and we will continue working throughout the implementation process to make this policy as strong as possible for Virginians and their families."
-Rhena Hicks, Freedom Virginia co-Executive Director
---

name: Jackson Lahmeyer
subject: Very BIG Endorsement!
body:
Over the next several weeks, #LahmeyerForCongress will begin to announce some very exciting endorsements... I want to share with you one that is VERY
| | [](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14586.1.5e6ade4fcf2edb0565acff1227b00a29)
---
[](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14587.1.1b509489d569c2d39122915e4c18944d) |
---
Over the next several weeks, [#LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14588.1.e7e397acdb7caee50b4b127e3fdbda7f) will begin to announce some very exciting endorsements... I want to share with you one that is **VERY BIG** because of how **RARE** the endorsement is. I am honored to be endorsed by the **Oklahoma Republican Party Chairwoman** , _Charity Linch_. It is **VERY RARE** for the State Party Chair to weigh in on a Republican Primary. However, **Charity Linch** is a woman of great _courage_ and _integrity_ , and I am beyond grateful to have her support in this race. I will do my best to make Charity and you proud if I am fortunate enough to be elected. We are just **55 days until** ELECTION DAY! It is time for **ALL HANDS ON DECK!** We started so strong and in order to finish strong I need **YOUR** help. We are having our **1st Team Gathering** on Monday, April 27 at 6:30pm at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14589.1.ef4e6e8e2ae99fdacd8ed072a76d86d4) in Tulsa, OK. If you want to **knock doors** , **make calls** , **spread the word** , and **help us win** Oklahoma’s 1st District, I need you there. **I have 3 simple asks** : -1 **Please Pray** for Me & My Family. -2 **Please Attend** our Volunteer Gathering on April 27. -3 **Please Host** a Meet & Greet at your home or business w/6-12 friends & family members. This is an opportunity for them to meet me and ask any questions they have. If you will host a meet & greet please email me at **jackson@jacksonlahmeyer.com** and we will set it up ASAP! (_This is a key to winning this race_). I also want to thank the over **600 individual donors** who have partnered with us so far. You can help us win this election by donating at [www.jacksonlahmeyer.com](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14590.1.c6a718e51a2a4595c6b75a7176abf969) Your help allows us to be on TV, radio and send out mailers. Also, please consider posting on social media that you support #[LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14591.1.6fd0cbab4935a3223cc060d1676c289e) this makes a BIG difference. I promise that if you will help me get elected that I will do my very best to make you proud. Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer
---
| | [ Partner w/The Mission Of Lahmeyer For Congress ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14592.1.197c2124009ae22fc88239761709a4a9)
---
|
---
---
## Our Path To VICTORY!
---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14593.1.1defc50e16254a64114dc0245bbc6090)
---
I want to take a moment and share with you the **pathway of VICTORY** for #[LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14594.1.a8a3d7015a7b4f08507616d60e91b528). In 2018, there was a very crowded field of Republican candidates running for CD1. **Kevin Hern** got into the runoff with **22.7% of the vote** and then went on to win the runoff and general election. His path to victory is also our path to victory. The race I am in is a very crowded field (12 candidates!) but this crowded field helps us. When I ran for Senate in 2022, we **over performed** beyond everyone's expectations. All the polls and experts said we would be lucky to break 10%. Across the state of Oklahoma we actually got 26% of the vote but that's not as exciting as what I am about to share with you. In 2022, I received around **32% of the vote in Congressional District 1**. That means, if I can hold the base of voters that already voted for me once then we could find ourselves in the runoff which positions us for victory like **Congressman Kevin Hern** in 2018. Here are the advantages that #[LahmeyerForCongress](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=29006799.14595.1.c2d4cc3583d7e36acf5a15593404fe1b) has against all the other candidates that are running. **First** , my name has appeared already on a ballot across CD1 (name ID is a major factor in primary elections). **Second** , there are only 55 days until the election on June 16 which helps us tremendously because it will be very difficult for all the candidates to introduce themselves to the voters across the entire district. **Third** , I have already received enough votes in this district to position me for the runoff if we can hold our base. I truly believe that we are positioned to win this election. In order to do so, we need to make sure our base of voters know that I am in it and what I will do if I was fortunate enough to be elected. I am running for Congress in Oklahoma's 1st District to do several things: **-Keep Our Borders Secure** **-Remove Illegal Criminals From Our Streets** **-Help Make Living In America Affordable For Americans** **-Not Allowing The Chinese Communist Party To Own American Farmland** **-Ensuring That Sharia Law Never Takes Root In Our Nation** I promise that if you will help me get elected that I will do my very best to make you proud. Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer
