| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

_But now, Peter, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth.

And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default.

Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country.

It's up to us to finish what he started.

One chapter. One student. One school at a time.

Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love.

**P.S.** There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out...

He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning.

When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. _**We don 't have time to wait.**_**" **

And he was right.

The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers.

We may be in 13% of our schools now...

_But in the other 87%? _

The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them.

And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous."

You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it.

He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses.

And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now.

**Peter, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- _this is it._ **

You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do.

But you can send them the tools to do it.

These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead.

All they're waiting on... is us.

clean_body: The plan was bold. The results are real. | | | | | Peter, If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left... If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good... If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, " Is it already too late?" You're not alone. A lot of good people have been asking the same question. But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools. That was no small feat. Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked. So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle. Then Charlie called me... He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster." I told him, "We are." Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools." I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America." "Okay," he said, "How many are there?" "About 27,000." Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!" I'll be honest -- I froze. We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet. But he wasn't fazed. He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together." That was Charlie. He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday." He believed in going now. And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself. He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality. That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place. That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: We're in 3,300. That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America. Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide. ✅ Florida ✅ Texas ✅ Tennessee ✅ Oklahoma ✅ Montana ✅ Nebraska ✅ Arkansas ✅ Indiana And we're just getting started. Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country... That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom. That 's what Club America is about... Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. But now, Peter, the question is... What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? Because here's the truth: These students aren't just signing up. They 're stepping up. They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous. But that isn't stopping them. They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever. They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, but brave. Not just loud, but principled. Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses. Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship. Charlie wanted a Club America chapter in every high school so no student would ever feel alone for loving God, defending their country, or believing in truth. And so the next generation wouldn't be handed over to the Left by default. Let's make Charlie's dream real -- 27,000 high schools. And a generation that doesn't apologize for loving this country. It's up to us to finish what he started. One chapter. One student. One school at a time. Let's move faster. Let's push further. Let's get this done -- for Charlie, and for the country we all love. | | For Charlie, Andrew Sypher Chief Field OfficerTurning Point USA P.S. There's one part of that phone call with Charlie I was going to leave out... He wasn't just dreaming big -- he was issuing a warning. When he told me we needed to move faster, he added: "The enemy is moving younger. They're coming after students earlier. We don 't have time to wait." And he was right. The Left has deeply embedded themselves in our schools -- rewriting history, poisoning young minds, and raising their next generation of radical foot soldiers. We may be in 13% of our schools now... But in the other 87%? The Left has free rein. Zero resistance. No voice to challenge them. And if we don't flood those schools with truth -- fast -- we'll have a generation that thinks loving America is "fascist," that faith is "hateful," and that freedom and free speech is "dangerous." You know it. I know it. Charlie knew it. He knew the fight for America's future would be won or lost in high school classrooms and on college campuses. And that fight has never been more urgent than it is right now. Peter, if you 've ever wondered whether one small act could change the direction of our country -- this is it. You may not be able to step into a hostile high school and stand for truth like these students do. But you can send them the tools to do it. These students are ready. They've raised their hands. They chose courage and decided to lead. All they're waiting on... is us. Every $25 helps send an activism kit to a young patriot and gives them everything they need to win hearts and minds. You're gift reminds them they're not alone. It gives them the confidence to stand and fight back. And you'll be saving our country -- one future freedom fighter at a time. 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

body:
I will never stop fighting for my family.

| | | | | | | | | | | My favorite title will always and forever be **Mom.**

My four children are the light of my life. On the days where I feel defeated by the countless political attacks, I remember why I'm doing this: to leave behind a stronger and safer country for my kids and the next generation.
---
| | [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYwNDIyX1pFLVpCLjExNDUxMF90MTg3ODAyOC0yMDY4JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDQyMl9aRS1aQi4xMTQ1MTBfdDE4NzgwMjgtMjA2OCZ4aWQ9VjEuYkJSMENXbEpsTjBremM0NlJBNzRaclNOQW1pc2hMUTRTRHJITVJSMlVENVQ2Y3dBQmphVWVOWF9HWWZHcHBDVCJ9/-4yirAy7XPpFyd2vKweQ3g)
---
| | My fight for our country is a fight for who I love. I will go to the farthest of lengths in order to be successful.
---
| |
* I NEVER want them to worry about the price of groceries or gasoline.
* I NEVER want them to fear who might be roaming our neighborhood streets because of open border policies.
* I NEVER want my children to question whether America is the greatest country on the face of the earth.

---
| | Instead,
---
| |
* I want them to be proud of the progress and accomplishments of our leaders.
* I want them to feel safe and secure.
* I want them to feel the pride of being an American.

---
| | One day you and I will be gone, and I want to know that I did everything I could to leave behind a stronger and safer country for my kids.

That's why I'm doing this. I can't stand asking for help. Sometimes I wonder what would have happened if I never got off the couch and ran for office...but then I remember that America is always worth protecting...no matter what!

If you want to see more regular, everyday moms in office instead of career politicians, then I need your urgent help. **[**Can you spare anything - even just $10 - to help me defend this critical battleground seat?**](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjYwNDIyX1pFLVpCLjExNDUxMF90MTg3ODAyOC0yMDY4JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDQyMl9aRS1aQi4xMTQ1MTBfdDE4NzgwMjgtMjA2OCZ4aWQ9VjEuYkJSMENXbEpsTjBremM0NlJBNzRaclNOQW1pc2hMUTRTRHJITVJSMlVENVQ2Y3dBQmphVWVOWF9HWWZHcHBDVCJ9/1Hx-yGWFuDa1ZoxZWMPnrA)**

Friends -
First and foremost, I want to thank you for the support you've given me through all of my campaigns.
I am no fan of having to send out these emails and text messages. Sometimes I have a hard time wrapping my head around the idea that people actually contribute in response to them.
But hundreds of thousands of people have -- and there's no telling what the outcome of my previous races may have been if they ignored messages like this.
Today, I am asking you to join them. Here's why:
The outcome of this election will determine whether we are able to put a check on President Trump during the final two years of his term. We have to take back the House and the Senate.
Taking those majorities back will run through Michigan, where we have a Senate seat we must defend and a few key House races we can flip from red to blue. And I am also being asked to travel to help elect Democrats in red and purple places that Donald Trump won, and where I know we can flip.
All that takes resources, so I am asking people who care to step up and help as the election heats up.

body:
We wanted to make sure you saw this!
#
Peter,
We wanted to make sure you saw this! **Governor Walz is launching Small Town PAC to put power back in the hands of our neighbors and help Democrats expand the map.**
This is about standing up for our schools, our jobs, and our communities, and making sure the people shaping our politics actually understand the places they’re asking to represent.
**[Will you chip in now to become a founding donor of Small Town PAC and help kick this work off strong from day one?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260422.dvtaSu&amount=5&refcode=em20260422-508&t=1&akid=508%2E34582%2EyirpMK)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260422.dvtaSu&amount=5&refcode=20260422-508&t=20&akid=508%2E34582%2EyirpMK)**
— Small Town PAC
* * *
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260422.dvtaSu&amount=5&refcode=em20260422-508&t=21&akid=508%2E34582%2EyirpMK)
Peter, I have some big news. **I’m launching something new today** , and I want you to be a part of it from the jump.
I grew up in the kind of small town where everybody knew everybody, everybody’s kids played together, and everybody helped when someone was in trouble.
We used to gather together as neighbors to celebrate after football games and graduations. More often than not, our gatherings took place at our local public school.
My public school was foundational. It was more than my education and the name on my jersey: it was the place our town came to meet. Heck, the school was the town.
As I’ve visited small towns in other states over the years, I’ve witnessed a similar sentiment. In red districts and blue, I’ve heard about cherished local schools and how they serve as the cornerstones of their communities.
But nowadays I’m seeing a disturbing new trend as those cornerstones are starting to crumble: **Local schools are closing after funding cuts, and they’re followed by other foundational pieces of the community.**
The local grocery store? _Gone._ The local clinic? _Gone_. The job with a decent wage? _Gone_.
Everyone and everything seems to be packing up and leaving town. We’re losing our neighbors. We’re losing our communities. And we aren't talking to each other anymore.
This is what it looks like to defund and divide America, and it’s because of Republicans like Donald Trump and JD Vance, who are willing to sell out our communities and working families for their own political and financial gain.
Why is Elon Musk closing schools in America? Why are we being told that any of the hardships our communities are facing have to do with immigration? The problem isn't your neighbor. It’s the tech bros and billionaires who pay to take turns cosplaying as your Congressman, your Senator, and your President.
I think folks in small towns need to band together and stand up for our schools, our jobs, and our communities before they’re all gone.
**It’s time to put the power back into the hands of our neighbors, and for Democrats to expand the map. That’s why I’m excited to launch Small Town PAC.**
I’m ready to pass the baton and get out on the road to find some teachers, nurses, veterans, laborers, and young people in small towns across the country who can represent their communities better than Silicon Valley and corrupt Republicans.
We need a new generation of elected leaders in this country – and lord knows the Democrats need some new faces. So let’s go recruit some good people with bold energy and fresh ideas who actually understand small towns and are willing to fight for them.
We’re on a mission to build a party that invests in small towns and delivers a message that resonates with rural America.
[**If you believe in putting small towns back at the forefront of American politics, rush a donation and become a founding donor to Small Towns PAC on Day 1.**](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260422.dvtaSu&amount=5&refcode=em20260422-508&t=22&akid=508%2E34582%2EyirpMK)
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20260422.dvtaSu&amount=5&refcode=20260422-508&t=41&akid=508%2E34582%2EyirpMK)**
Let’s start talking to each other again about the issues that actually impact us. Let’s start taking the fight to the venture capitalists and robber barons who are ripping our communities apart. And let’s go win some elections!
I’m grateful to kick off this new journey with you, Peter.
More soon,
Tim

| | Hi Friend,

I’m running for re‐election to represent California’s 12th Congressional District in the June 2026 Primary.

Now more than halfway through my first term in Congress, our grassroots movement has only grown stronger thanks to supporters like you. I’m proud of the work we’ve done — from fighting for affordable health care, tackling the housing crisis, and investing in the care economy that holds our families together. Representing my community in Congress is the honor of my life, and I’m deeply grateful for the trust the East Bay has placed in me. I’m fighting every day to bring back federal funding for our communities, advocate for expanded opportunities, and defend our most basic rights - and being unrelenting in pushing back against a lawless Administration. I’m running for re‐election because our communities deserve:
* Affordable housing and reliable public transit
* Safe communities
* Immigrant rights
* Health care and reproductive freedom
* A democracy that is truly inclusive and accountable

body:
Yesterday, the New York Times reported that Donald Trump is planning to send some of our Afghan allies to the Congo.
#
Peter, this is urgent.
Yesterday, _The New York Times_ reported that Donald Trump is planning to send some of our Afghan allies to the Congo. If they choose not to go, they will be returned to Afghanistan, where they will almost certainly be killed by the Taliban.
**Lives are on the line, and we must act. Now.**
[**Add your name and DEMAND that Donald Trump reverse course on this outrageous plan. These people bled for us, and they need our help now.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260422_VV_AFGHAN_ALLIES/?source=em260422-1-60&refcode2=35099.3013755.2Wfzx0&akid=35099%2E3013755%2E2Wfzx0)
| [SIGN ON NOW](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260422_VV_AFGHAN_ALLIES/?source=em260422-1-60&refcode2=35099.3013755.2Wfzx0&akid=35099%2E3013755%2E2Wfzx0)
---
Thousands of brave Afghan men and women worked for and supported the United States in Afghanistan. They all did so at great risk to themselves and their families. We promised to care for them and offer them safety should their country ever fall.
After we withdrew in 2021, some of those allies were able to evacuate here, and others to friendly nations. Far, far too many were left behind, and many have already been killed.
**This is a moral stain on this country that will not be lifted in our lifetimes.** It is infuriating, and will have a serious impact both on our reputation and our capability to wage and win wars. Our failure here **_will_** come back to haunt us in future conflicts when we find ourselves in need of allies on the ground.
VoteVets is mobilizing action on Capitol Hill to stop this, but the only way to guarantee action is for the American people to raise hell. The least we can do is speak out against this, and I am asking you to add your voice.
Specifically, each of us has a US Representative and two US Senators. Their staff are trained and organized to take our calls and to inform their boss about what we say. I have seen them work and they are terrific. Please call them on this matter.
**And please:[Demand that Trump stop this. These Afghans fought by our sides. They put their lives on the line. We made them promises, and they will die if we do not keep our word.](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260422_VV_AFGHAN_ALLIES/?source=em260422-1-60&refcode2=35099.3013755.2Wfzx0&akid=35099%2E3013755%2E2Wfzx0)**
| [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.votevets.org/signup/260422_VV_AFGHAN_ALLIES/?source=em260422-1-60&refcode2=35099.3013755.2Wfzx0&akid=35099%2E3013755%2E2Wfzx0)
---
Please. This cannot wait.
V/R
Paul Eaton
Major General, U.S. Army, Retired
Senior Advisor, VoteVets

| | |

I’ll be direct, Derek:
Today, I’m asking you to split a donation of $5 between me and James Talarico – the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Texas. He’s building an unprecedented grassroots movement, and he needs our help. **[Will you chip in?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53177?t=2&akid=10714%2E434096%2E17NQTv)**
| | [CHIP IN $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53177?t=3&akid=10714%2E434096%2E17NQTv)
---
James is an eighth-generation Texan, a former middle school teacher, and a Presbyterian seminarian. He believes that the biggest divide in our country isn’t left vs. right – it’s top vs. bottom.
I couldn’t agree more. 💯
James knows what it takes to bring people together and fight for the working class and not the ultrawealthy and special interests, because he’s done it before. **Now, he’s ready to keep up this critical work in the Senate, and I’m proud to support him.**
Here’s the problem: The GOP and right-wing megadonors are already pouring in MILLIONS to try to crush his momentum, and **unless we fight back now, we’ll lose our best chance to help Texas elect a senator who *actually* cares about working people.**
**[So please, Derek, have James’ back like you’ve always had mine. With Senate control on the line, will you split an urgent donation of $5 or more now to help us win in Texas and retake power for working people?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/53177?t=4&akid=10714%2E434096%2E17NQTv)**

John Fetterman

name: Nick Melvoin
subject: It's official! We passed my resolution to reduce screens in schools.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nick Melvoin for School Board 2026, 1787 Tribute Road, Suite K, Sacramento, CA, 95815
body:
NBC News: "Los Angeles becomes the first major school district to require screen time limits."

| | | | | [|
---](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=011044088f&e=3cf484ad56)
| | | | |
---
| | Peter,
It’s official. **We passed my resolution to reduce screens in schools.**
In an increasingly technological age, screens are a fact of life. During the COVID-19 pandemic, they were a lifeline for our students. But parents across the nation have commented on how dependent their children on becoming on technology. **It’s time for a reset.**
My resolution will **remove screens entirely for kids before second grade** and audit our approach districtwide. It’s time to get kids back to **outdoor play** and **hands-on learning**.
As a new dad, I think about what my son’s relationship with technology will be every day. These are critical conversations to be having, and the work certainly doesn’t end with this resolution. [**We’re just getting started, and we need your help.**](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=a0240ea1b3&e=3cf484ad56)
We need the resources for voters to hear about this important work we’re doing. If you support my resolution to reevaluate our relationship with technology, [**please make a contribution to help us reach voters across the district.**](https://nickmelvoin.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e47425f168c0b7b00df186831&id=8e713dd399&e=3cf484ad56)

body:
Chris is a proven fighter for working families — and he’s seen tough campaigns like this before. He knows it takes grassroots support to win a race like this. That’s why I’m reaching out to you today, Renee.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102660?refcode=em20260422-10336&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10336%2E614464%2ETkBtN_)
Peter, it’s Governor JB Pritzker.
I’m emailing you today about New Hampshire’s Senate race because this is serious: **Senate Republicans’ hand-picked candidate, John Sununu, jumped in to defeat Chris Pappas and flip this open Senate seat red.**
**[Before I go any further, I have to ask: Will you split $15 or more between Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee to keep New Hampshire blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102660?refcode=em20260422-10336&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10336%2E614464%2ETkBtN_)**
_Without Chris Pappas winning in New Hampshire, Democrats won’t have a chance at taking back a majority in the Senate._ That’s why this race is being targeted by GOP super PACs and Republicans across the country.
The NRSC — which pours millions into electing Republicans to the Senate — said they’re “all-in” on John Sununu. And polling shows: This race is a _statistical dead heat_ between Chris Pappas and John Sununu.

name: Dr. Michael Mann
subject: Why I’m reaching out to you this Earth Day
body:
I wanted to personally reach out today, on Earth Day, to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival.
#
[](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22697?c0=314_2026_climate_fr.pBRE6g&refcode=em20260422-1616&t=1&akid=1616%2E2118727%2EodTjcl)
I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet.
I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Congressional Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years.
I wanted to personally reach out today, on Earth Day, to say first and foremost: **In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival.**
But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist.
It isn’t too late for us to change course. But our window to act is closing, and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans hold onto power in November and continue to roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few decades (something I explore in [my new book ‘Science Under Siege: How to Fight the 5 Most Powerful Forces that Threaten Our World](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22698?t=2&akid=1616%2E2118727%2EodTjcl).)
I’m humbly asking: [**Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action in honor of Earth Day? They are working to elect hundreds of climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government, and they can’t do this work without you.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22697?c0=314_2026_climate_fr.pBRE6g&refcode=em20260422-1616&t=3&akid=1616%2E2118727%2EodTjcl)
**You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work:** I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world.
Under Democratic Presidents and Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law over the years.
That progress is being erased and undone by Republicans unlike ever before. They’ve handed the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry and climate deniers who have a personal and financial interest in obstructing the transition to green and renewable technology.
**For humanity’s sake, we need to get back on track. As. Soon. As. Possible.**
My friends at 314 Action elected the only climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate if elected this November – in Congress and state legislatures across the country.
Our window to act is closing. So I’m asking you to act: [**Join me in supporting 314 Action this Earth Day and let’s elect a historic wave of Democratic scientists who will lead the fight on climate.**](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=314_2026_climate_fr.LoZkan&refcode=em20260422-1616&t=4&akid=1616%2E2118727%2EodTjcl)
**[DONATE ››](https://act.leftnet.org/go/21583?c0=314_2026_climate_fr.LoZkan&refcode=em20260422-1616&t=5&akid=1616%2E2118727%2EodTjcl)**
Thank you,
Dr. Michael Mann
_Climate Scientist & Geophysicist_
_Presidential Distinguished Professor of Atmospheric Science at University of Pennsylvania_
_Director of Penn Center for Science, Sustainability and the Media_
_World Sustainability Award Recipient 2019_
_Tyler Prize for Environmental Achievement Recipient_

**LeftNet is an online political network fighting for progressive causes and candidates focused on social, racial, economic, and environmental justice.**

| Peter,

After two years of chaos and cruelty, Michiganders have had enough and are ready for someone who will actually stand up and fight back.

That’s why I’m running for Congress. I’m running to take this fight to Washington, hold Trump accountable, and meet this moment head-on.

subject: When There Is Smoke... Earth Day 2026
body:
| |

|
---
Peter,

---
How many times have you heard the phrase "where there is smoke, there is fire"? Recently, I read [an article](https://clicksp.mariaforstlouis.com/f/a/BppuSkfWYhHEYPMy1b_04A~~/AAPPABA~/nT_rt3_rv99Q3S9YK9tY_F5SM6mMGVufeVQI73gGe_nGf7BEAQLGUd993jRmOyendXSBtMow5WPdmCNgfwfbSXF4R6OuSZCH1rYD_uudvCPJ_uxQXoiTW4ejl3cqcpwSoW4RTPKbNv9a2l1D9VddV_KIWi9PzTEMOS_zlZG2yvrr0k5BWqnZvqrQOTsx-XBlhxFfG8HjGro04E4kc0eFkp-lnf85aX7S-ndfAMbfo7k4K6pG1eXTSeBJiWr8Y9qj3lAhE2ltGY7gDUy9gcKJ7KfFiRKBtvBcgP2t072sDi728k9cxL7CfAL5THdfOHycI5THfhjqJi3hvIa_b7U4EMqZOF0OPirGyw5Dh_P2RvE~) written by Nassim Benchaabane of the Post-Dispatch calling out the soil moved from the Olive Market project to the Ruth Park golf course in University City. At first glance, and after skimming key words and non-responses in the article, I was alarmed the soil was not tested before it was moved. Certainly there would be a follow up article in the paper. For now, no such luck. Here's why I'm concerned about something that may seem trivial to those not paying attention. For the last 16 years, I've tracked the movement of soil. It's not something that was planned, but rather a result of my research investigating radioactive waste and dioxin contamination in St. Louis and how it impacts the health of residential and non-residential communities. One thing an evolving city can count on is migrating soil - natural and manmade. No matter where soil originates, it should always be tested. As St. Louis grew in population, housing and business development became important to sustaining the region. However, knowing and unknowing haulers, concrete makers and citizens participated in the movement of contaminated soil. Whether it was a new housing development built after the early 1940's or a grandmother transporting "soil" to her in-ground garden in Berkeley or workers using soil or "rough gravel" for cement or concrete to lay in basements, sidewalks or playgrounds in Ferguson, everyone is at risk. St. Louis' history of soil migration should not go unrecognized, as it is a reason for many of our illnesses. Today, the movement of soil should still be a concern. Municipalities, County and City governments have praised development, as many of us have, but have ignored the risk factors to workers and families. When soil is not tested almost anything can occur. By way of example, as a young child, I enjoyed making mud pies with soil at my home built in 1940. While original soil may have not been contaminated, a series of floods throughout time may have transported contamination into the soil in areas where I played and where children play now. My environmental research has taken me to the City of St. Louis, Ballwin, Pike County, Kansas City, Chesterfield and other places in Missouri. But I always focused on the St. Louis County senate district I once represented and hoped the elected representatives in the other areas would do their own due diligence to follow up on my work. But, as of now, they haven't. Here are some examples why every local elected leader should care. The homes off of St. Louis Avenue, between Greer and Norwood sit on an out-of-use and unregulated landfill. No one in St. Louis City has followed up on the subsidence, the fact homes are sinking and people have gotten ill with rare diseases. African American doctors and lawyers moved to that neighborhood in the 1960s as it was sold as a place for the up-and-coming. What did the developers know? Why wasn't anything done to warn the residents back then or now? There are three locations in Clayton that have been of concern to some residents. It took the son of a former physicist at Washington University to tell me about two of the locations, alongside Jojo, someone I once babysat when I was a student at Clayton High School. As an adult, Jojo informed me that several young ladies in her neighborhood were impacted by thyroid cancer in their early 20s, an indication early exposure may have occurred. The specific neighborhood is one location mentioned by the physicist's son and also a location where there was a reported truck spill decades ago. No elected official did anything about it. If you drive down Skinker Boulevard now, you may notice the construction next to a church and the Forsyth School, where I once attended. It's frightening to think of the number of people, especially children, who were and are impacted by radioactive waste in that neighborhood. If you're familiar with the previous St. Louis County Board of Elections (BOE) in Maplewood, it too sits on an out-of-use and unregulated landfill where dioxin and radioactive waste were reportedly dispensed with. I obtained a list of nine BOE workers, mostly women, who had cancer at some point while working at that facility. Their cancers are generally associated with radioactive waste exposure. I raised issues about this as a state senator and was ignored by St. Louis County, OSHA and the US Department of Energy, the Maplewood City Council and the Missouri Department of Natural Resources. Below is a picture of the smoke in the Maplewood landfill.

---
There are other locations of makeshift landfills in places you'd never expect in St. Louis City and County. It has been my personal and professional mission to find each one. Another Post-Dispatch writer wrote a magnificent and detailed article - some years ago - about one of Paul McKee's failed projects and bankruptcy. It is this example in particular that caused me to track the movement of soil even closer. The evidentiary documentation was over 500 pages in the bankruptcy lawsuit McKee once faced. At this old landfill near the airport, Mckee basically allowed for the contents to be spread out to level the ground. The contents had an assortment of chemicals including radioactive waste, dioxin, arsenic, asbestos, PCBs, organic and inorganic matter. Monsanto, Wagner Electric, Mallinckrodt and McDonnell Douglas dumped at the out-of-use and unregulated landfill. 80% of the people who lived in the area became ill with cancer or an auto-immune disease. The list of dumping companies and haulers visiting this site is long. This area was part of the district I represented while serving in the Missouri senate. Many of the surviving families live in the St. Louis County Council seat that I am running for now. Only the memories survive as the illnesses persist, plaguing these families and future generations. Here is my video from 2017. The construction workers were never told about the landfill contamination. I brought it up on the senate floor multiple times. No one paid any attention then either. In this case, official documents prove the state and St. Louis County failed adequate oversight and the correct remediation process.

| [ ](https://clicksp.mariaforstlouis.com/f/a/93ntwtsCUmf-h3G5tmE-wg~~/AAPPABA~/w95TC9gN3-oISs5DBeBbSG2dvWlSQTA08VABQue34wLT1tEtuBkyKpnZndvVmnHRP2w0pAYyg3iH6SREWhBj4yANz2XPB9BnlC9yVm62aMuVhwqR5U9kJzqBcM3rULafJ7M5TTvF9dmumD6BtgwOmMAv9fVgv0NOGbfBJocUO-sevjSA4-1lRgH5feJfLWPO0nSc7FlLht3WcChKthHBjJSv04-3s25H7C0KuO8j3kmkaLvrWkzat8E2jSy2aJJ_HdpbKddLrgpiAQ_csx9Ty7gLkDIDgMbSGj4fKNpR-m0~)
---
In North St. Louis County, there are multiple sites that I have found over the years that are rippled with contamination in and around homes, in school yards and places of employment. One place is a neighborhood along Lindbergh. The businesses mandate their employees to only drink bottled water. However, our local, state and federal governments allow residents in the same neighborhood to drink water from the tap without any warning at all. As your next County Councilwoman, I will change these inconsistancies. St. Louis County has failed to alert residents of the dangers that exist for decades. That's why I am running for the St. Louis County Council - to rip off the scab of silence. It's past time residents know the truth! Citizens deserve to know the truth about the water they drink, the soil their children play in and the toxic air they breathe. It takes just one particulate to change a person's DNA over time, which may lead to cancer or an autoimmune disease. It didn't take a Harvard study to tell me children exposed to radioactive waste get sicker quicker. I already knew this by the stories I've collected for 16 years. My research is quite expansive, unmatched and sought after by both WashU and Josh Hawley. And I can define erasure and environmental racism in 50 different ways. Both the corporate developers (that fund one opponent) and the County executive (who is headed to court for two felonies and supporting the other opponent) want to keep this swept under the carpet for decades to come. St. Louis County deserves leaders who will not bend to corporate interests and their profits, but rather fight for the well-being of workers and families who deserve better than the stale service they are getting now. The out-of-date policies of the past are getting us nowhere fast, regardless of what the issue may be. Finally, the second world war was over 75+ years ago. It's time to uncover the secrets. It is time to be proactive. The clock is ticking. We all deserve clean water, clean air, safe homes and places of employment. #EarthDay2026 Please consider joining my campaign efforts. We need a councilwoman that cares about the health and well-being of every St. Louisan regardless of where they live in the region. Thank You.

clean_body: | | | Peter, How many times have you heard the phrase "where there is smoke, there is fire"? Recently, I read ~ written by Nassim Benchaabane of the Post-Dispatch calling out the soil moved from the Olive Market project to the Ruth Park golf course in University City. At first glance, and after skimming key words and non-responses in the article, I was alarmed the soil was not tested before it was moved. Certainly there would be a follow up article in the paper. For now, no such luck. Here's why I'm concerned about something that may seem trivial to those not paying attention. For the last 16 years, I've tracked the movement of soil. It's not something that was planned, but rather a result of my research investigating radioactive waste and dioxin contamination in St. Louis and how it impacts the health of residential and non-residential communities. One thing an evolving city can count on is migrating soil - natural and manmade. No matter where soil originates, it should always be tested. As St. Louis grew in population, housing and business development became important to sustaining the region. However, knowing and unknowing haulers, concrete makers and citizens participated in the movement of contaminated soil. Whether it was a new housing development built after the early 1940's or a grandmother transporting "soil" to her in-ground garden in Berkeley or workers using soil or "rough gravel" for cement or concrete to lay in basements, sidewalks or playgrounds in Ferguson, everyone is at risk. St. Louis' history of soil migration should not go unrecognized, as it is a reason for many of our illnesses. Today, the movement of soil should still be a concern. Municipalities, County and City governments have praised development, as many of us have, but have ignored the risk factors to workers and families. When soil is not tested almost anything can occur. By way of example, as a young child, I enjoyed making mud pies with soil at my home built in 1940. While original soil may have not been contaminated, a series of floods throughout time may have transported contamination into the soil in areas where I played and where children play now. My environmental research has taken me to the City of St. Louis, Ballwin, Pike County, Kansas City, Chesterfield and other places in Missouri. But I always focused on the St. Louis County senate district I once represented and hoped the elected representatives in the other areas would do their own due diligence to follow up on my work. But, as of now, they haven't. Here are some examples why every local elected leader should care. The homes off of St. Louis Avenue, between Greer and Norwood sit on an out-of-use and unregulated landfill. No one in St. Louis City has followed up on the subsidence, the fact homes are sinking and people have gotten ill with rare diseases. African American doctors and lawyers moved to that neighborhood in the 1960s as it was sold as a place for the up-and-coming. What did the developers know? Why wasn't anything done to warn the residents back then or now? There are three locations in Clayton that have been of concern to some residents. It took the son of a former physicist at Washington University to tell me about two of the locations, alongside Jojo, someone I once babysat when I was a student at Clayton High School. As an adult, Jojo informed me that several young ladies in her neighborhood were impacted by thyroid cancer in their early 20s, an indication early exposure may have occurred. The specific neighborhood is one location mentioned by the physicist's son and also a location where there was a reported truck spill decades ago. No elected official did anything about it. If you drive down Skinker Boulevard now, you may notice the construction next to a church and the Forsyth School, where I once attended. It's frightening to think of the number of people, especially children, who were and are impacted by radioactive waste in that neighborhood. If you're familiar with the previous St. Louis County Board of Elections (BOE) in Maplewood, it too sits on an out-of-use and unregulated landfill where dioxin and radioactive waste were reportedly dispensed with. I obtained a list of nine BOE workers, mostly women, who had cancer at some point while working at that facility. Their cancers are generally associated with radioactive waste exposure. I raised issues about this as a state senator and was ignored by St. Louis County, OSHA and the US Department of Energy, the Maplewood City Council and the Missouri Department of Natural Resources. Below is a picture of the smoke in the Maplewood landfill. | ~ There are other locations of makeshift landfills in places you'd never expect in St. Louis City and County. It has been my personal and professional mission to find each one. Another Post-Dispatch writer wrote a magnificent and detailed article - some years ago - about one of Paul McKee's failed projects and bankruptcy. It is this example in particular that caused me to track the movement of soil even closer. The evidentiary documentation was over 500 pages in the bankruptcy lawsuit McKee once faced. At this old landfill near the airport, Mckee basically allowed for the contents to be spread out to level the ground. The contents had an assortment of chemicals including radioactive waste, dioxin, arsenic, asbestos, PCBs, organic and inorganic matter. Monsanto, Wagner Electric, Mallinckrodt and McDonnell Douglas dumped at the out-of-use and unregulated landfill. 80% of the people who lived in the area became ill with cancer or an auto-immune disease. The list of dumping companies and haulers visiting this site is long. This area was part of the district I represented while serving in the Missouri senate. Many of the surviving families live in the St. Louis County Council seat that I am running for now. Only the memories survive as the illnesses persist, plaguing these families and future generations. Here is my video from 2017. The construction workers were never told about the landfill contamination. I brought it up on the senate floor multiple times. No one paid any attention then either. In this case, official documents prove the state and St. Louis County failed adequate oversight and the correct remediation process. | ~ In North St. Louis County, there are multiple sites that I have found over the years that are rippled with contamination in and around homes, in school yards and places of employment. One place is a neighborhood along Lindbergh. The businesses mandate their employees to only drink bottled water. However, our local, state and federal governments allow residents in the same neighborhood to drink water from the tap without any warning at all. As your next County Councilwoman, I will change these inconsistancies. St. Louis County has failed to alert residents of the dangers that exist for decades. That's why I am running for the St. Louis County Council - to rip off the scab of silence. It's past time residents know the truth! Citizens deserve to know the truth about the water they drink, the soil their children play in and the toxic air they breathe. It takes just one particulate to change a person's DNA over time, which may lead to cancer or an autoimmune disease. It didn't take a Harvard study to tell me children exposed to radioactive waste get sicker quicker. I already knew this by the stories I've collected for 16 years. My research is quite expansive, unmatched and sought after by both WashU and Josh Hawley. And I can define erasure and environmental racism in 50 different ways. Both the corporate developers (that fund one opponent) and the County executive (who is headed to court for two felonies and supporting the other opponent) want to keep this swept under the carpet for decades to come. St. Louis County deserves leaders who will not bend to corporate interests and their profits, but rather fight for the well-being of workers and families who deserve better than the stale service they are getting now. The out-of-date policies of the past are getting us nowhere fast, regardless of what the issue may be. Finally, the second world war was over 75+ years ago. It's time to uncover the secrets. It is time to be proactive. The clock is ticking. We all deserve clean water, clean air, safe homes and places of employment. #EarthDay2026 Please consider joining my campaign efforts. We need a councilwoman that cares about the health and well-being of every St. Louisan regardless of where they live in the region. Thank You. ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ | ~ For By Chappelle-Nadal For County Council. Maria Chappelle-Nadal, Treasurer. P.O. Box 300024 University City, MO 63130_ |

clean_body: | | | ********The longer Trump remains in power, the more endangered we become. The Trump regime’s agenda has moved from dangerous to deranged. Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the Secretary of Health and Human Services, was just busted for his chilling vision. While on a podcast in 2024, he claimed "all Black kids" are being medicated and suggested they need to be "re-parented" to government-run farms. Let that sink in. This is the same man who admits to butchering roadkill and is now pushing for a national autism registry. This isn't just weird, it is a direct threat to the autonomy, safety, and civil rights of the disability community and families of color. At Able Dems, we are working tirelessly to elect Democrats with disabilities and dedicated allies who will stand as a bulwark against this regime’s cruelty. We cannot allow people who view our children as experiments or farm labor to dictate national health policy. But here's the part we don't talk about enough: Individual action can only go so far when the people in power are moving us in the wrong direction.

I think about that a lot when I remember my time in college, out in the field testing water quality. Seeing firsthand how closely our health is tied to the safety of our natural resources stayed with me. Protecting our environment has never been a fight that can be won with _just_ personal habits – policy has to play a key role. It's about whether we have leaders willing to invest in clean water, extend Iowa’s renewable energy tax credits, and hold corporations accountable when they put profit over people.

**As a former environmental engineer,** I understand just how fragile and interconnected these systems are and how quickly damage can become irreversible. **And as a lawyer,** I know this: corporations and billionaires are not going to invest in Iowa out of the goodness of their hearts.

For decades, I've coached clients on the power of simple lifestyle changes to prevent illness and
optimize health. While modern medicine tends to favor expensive pharmaceuticals, our
grandparents knew the value of natural remedies--many of which science is now rediscovering.
One such powerhouse? Baking soda.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.PQsOWAsOeLqJhgT-etnU09vnU9VP2nWLHRaJ7Ye7wZU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=195049942)
Baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) has been used for centuries as a medicine, cleansing agent,
and digestive aid. Today, emerging research suggests it may do far more than just relieve
heartburn. From fighting inflammation to enhancing athletic performance, baking soda is a cost-
effective, natural remedy worth a second look.

Baking soda's history dates back to ancient Egypt, where it was used as a soap-like cleansing
agent. By the 19th century, American chemists John Dwight and Austin Church began mass-
producing it, and it quickly became a household staple. Before the rise of over-the-counter
medications, doctors regularly prescribed baking soda to treat indigestion, infections, and kidney
issues.

During the Spanish flu pandemic of 1918, baking soda was even recommended by the U.S.
government as a preventive treatment. Decades later, holistic practitioners and researchers began
exploring its benefits beyond basic home remedies.
Surprising Health Benefits of Baking Soda

One of the more controversial yet intriguing uses of baking soda is its potential role in cancer
treatment. Some research suggests that cancer cells thrive in an acidic environment, and since
baking soda is alkaline, it may help neutralize acidity in the body. While more studies are
needed, some doctors have explored its use alongside conventional therapies.

Baking soda is a natural antacid that neutralizes stomach acid, making it a go-to remedy for
heartburn and indigestion. A simple mix of half a teaspoon of baking soda in water can provide
relief. However, it should be used sparingly to avoid disrupting stomach acid balance.

Chronic inflammation is linked to numerous diseases, from arthritis to heart disease. A study
published in the Journal of Immunology found that baking soda may help reduce inflammation
by influencing the immune system's response. Some researchers believe it could help prevent
autoimmune diseases.

Elite athletes are now turning to baking soda for performance enhancement. According to a recent Wall Street Journal article, Olympic runners have been using baking soda supplements to buffer lactic acid buildup, reducing fatigue, and improving endurance. Some runners take it before a race in a controlled dose, as it helps delay muscle burn and extend high-intensity performance. This practice, known as "soda doping," has been studied for years, and some experts believe it may give athletes an edge in sports requiring short bursts of speed or endurance.

A New York Post article recently covered a viral trend of people using baking soda as a weight
loss aid. The theory is that drinking baking soda with water can improve digestion and boost
metabolism. However, while there's anecdotal evidence, more scientific research is needed to
confirm its direct impact on fat loss.

According to Verywell Health, using baking soda in saline nasal sprays or gargles can help clear
mucus and soothe sore throats. Some holistic practitioners recommend a baking soda rinse as a
way to support immune function during cold and flu season.

Some doctors prescribe baking soda to patients with chronic kidney disease to help reduce acid
levels in the body. A study published in the Journal of the American Society of
Nephrology found that sodium bicarbonate supplementation slowed the progression of kidney
disease in some patients.

While baking soda offers several health benefits, it's important to use it correctly. Here are some
safe ways to incorporate it into your daily routine:
 For Digestion: Mix 1⁄2 teaspoon of baking soda in 8 ounces of water and drink
occasionally to relieve heartburn or indigestion.
 For Oral Health: Use baking soda as a natural toothpaste or mouth rinse to neutralize
acidity and freshen breath.
 For Skin Irritations: Apply a paste of baking soda and water to insect bites, sunburns, or
minor rashes to reduce itching.
 For Post-Workout Recovery: Add 1⁄2 teaspoon to a glass of water after intense exercise
to buffer lactic acid and reduce muscle soreness.
 For Immune Support: Gargle with a mixture of warm water and baking soda to soothe a
sore throat.

Despite its affordability and effectiveness, baking soda (like many natural remedies) is often
ignored in favor of costly pharmaceutical treatments. Our grandparents relied on simple, natural
solutions to maintain their health--yet today, the medical industry is quick to push medications
over lifestyle adjustments.

As a health coach, I constantly remind my clients that prevention is always better than
treatment. Instead of waiting until sickness forces us into the healthcare system, we should take
proactive steps to maintain our well-being. Small daily habits--like incorporating baking soda, prioritizing whole foods, exercising, and managing stress--can have a profound impact on long-term health.

Baking soda is more than just a pantry staple; it's a powerful, science-backed tool for health and
wellness. From aiding digestion to reducing inflammation and enhancing athletic performance,
its benefits are vast and largely underappreciated.
As we rediscover the wisdom of previous generations, it's time to embrace simple, natural
solutions like baking soda as part of a proactive approach to health. Modern medicine has its
place, but nothing will ever replace the value of daily habits, preventive care, and the power of
God's creation in nature.

Baking soda (sodium bicarbonate) has been used for centuries as a medicine, cleansing agent, and digestive aid. Today, emerging research suggests it may do far more than just relieve heartburn. From fighting inflammation to enhancing athletic performance, baking soda is a cost- effective, natural remedy worth a second look. Baking soda's history dates back to ancient Egypt, where it was used as a soap-like cleansing agent. By the 19th century, American chemists John Dwight and Austin Church began mass- producing it, and it quickly became a household staple. Before the rise of over-the-counter medications, doctors regularly prescribed baking soda to treat indigestion, infections, and kidney issues. During the Spanish flu pandemic of 1918, baking soda was even recommended by the U.S. government as a preventive treatment. Decades later, holistic practitioners and researchers began exploring its benefits beyond basic home remedies. Surprising Health Benefits of Baking Soda One of the more controversial yet intriguing uses of baking soda is its potential role in cancer treatment. Some research suggests that cancer cells thrive in an acidic environment, and since baking soda is alkaline, it may help neutralize acidity in the body. While more studies are needed, some doctors have explored its use alongside conventional therapies. Baking soda is a natural antacid that neutralizes stomach acid, making it a go-to remedy for heartburn and indigestion. A simple mix of half a teaspoon of baking soda in water can provide relief. However, it should be used sparingly to avoid disrupting stomach acid balance. Chronic inflammation is linked to numerous diseases, from arthritis to heart disease. A study published in the Journal of Immunology found that baking soda may help reduce inflammation by influencing the immune system's response. Some researchers believe it could help prevent autoimmune diseases. Elite athletes are now turning to baking soda for performance enhancement. According to a recent Wall Street Journal article, Olympic runners have been using baking soda supplements to buffer lactic acid buildup, reducing fatigue, and improving endurance. Some runners take it before a race in a controlled dose, as it helps delay muscle burn and extend high-intensity performance. This practice, known as "soda doping," has been studied for years, and some experts believe it may give athletes an edge in sports requiring short bursts of speed or endurance. A New York Post article recently covered a viral trend of people using baking soda as a weight loss aid. The theory is that drinking baking soda with water can improve digestion and boost metabolism. However, while there's anecdotal evidence, more scientific research is needed to confirm its direct impact on fat loss. According to Verywell Health, using baking soda in saline nasal sprays or gargles can help clear mucus and soothe sore throats. Some holistic practitioners recommend a baking soda rinse as a way to support immune function during cold and flu season. Some doctors prescribe baking soda to patients with chronic kidney disease to help reduce acid levels in the body. A study published in the Journal of the American Society of Nephrology found that sodium bicarbonate supplementation slowed the progression of kidney disease in some patients. While baking soda offers several health benefits, it's important to use it correctly. Here are some safe ways to incorporate it into your daily routine:  For Digestion: Mix 1⁄2 teaspoon of baking soda in 8 ounces of water and drink occasionally to relieve heartburn or indigestion.  For Oral Health: Use baking soda as a natural toothpaste or mouth rinse to neutralize acidity and freshen breath.  For Skin Irritations: Apply a paste of baking soda and water to insect bites, sunburns, or minor rashes to reduce itching.  For Post-Workout Recovery: Add 1⁄2 teaspoon to a glass of water after intense exercise to buffer lactic acid and reduce muscle soreness.  For Immune Support: Gargle with a mixture of warm water and baking soda to soothe a sore throat. Despite its affordability and effectiveness, baking soda (like many natural remedies) is often ignored in favor of costly pharmaceutical treatments. Our grandparents relied on simple, natural solutions to maintain their health--yet today, the medical industry is quick to push medications over lifestyle adjustments. As a health coach, I constantly remind my clients that prevention is always better than treatment. Instead of waiting until sickness forces us into the healthcare system, we should take proactive steps to maintain our well-being. Small daily habits--like incorporating baking soda, prioritizing whole foods, exercising, and managing stress--can have a profound impact on long-term health. Baking soda is more than just a pantry staple; it's a powerful, science-backed tool for health and wellness. From aiding digestion to reducing inflammation and enhancing athletic performance, its benefits are vast and largely underappreciated. As we rediscover the wisdom of previous generations, it's time to embrace simple, natural solutions like baking soda as part of a proactive approach to health. Modern medicine has its place, but nothing will ever replace the value of daily habits, preventive care, and the power of God's creation in nature. subject: OLCV endorses Tina Kotek for re-election
body:
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/776539476973465672756231595A474C536368564335464F673332486C58455553314D65576C49522B62354E53346A7031777435644E7A6D4933377066634C68/editor_images/42226%20Gov%20Endorsement%20-%20email%20header%20%281%29.png]
Hi Peter,
We’re proud to share that OLCV has officially endorsed Governor Tina Kotek [https://www.tinafororegon.com/] for re-election.
At a moment when Donald Trump and his allies are working to roll back decades of environmental progress, Oregon needs steady, proven leadership. Governor Kotek has been a steady partner in defending our climate, protecting our communities, and moving our state forward.
Since taking office as Governor, she has:
* Re-established Oregon’s Climate Protection Program, putting us back on track to reduce climate pollution through 2050
* Secured $197 million in federal funding for climate solutions across Oregon
* Advanced clean energy development while protecting coastal and community interests
* Defended critical programs like Solar for All to expand access to affordable clean energy
* Committed to strong environmental protections, equity, and climate resilience across the state
Her climate leadership started before her time in the Governor’s office: as House Speaker, she helped pass one of the most ambitious clean energy laws in the country, committing Oregon to 100% clean electricity by 2040. And she’s committed to getting us on track to reach those goals.
Governor Kotek has proven she won’t back down when it matters most. She’s taken on federal attacks, defended environmental safeguards, and worked to ensure every Oregonian has access to clean air, clean water, and a healthy future.
That’s why we’re proud to stand with her again.
Together, we can keep Oregon moving forward on climate, protect the progress we’ve made, and continue building a healthier, more resilient future for all.
Join us in sharing this announcement with your networks by using this toolkit!
In solidarity,

body:
Today we are once again living through a moment that will live in history.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260422_1.blmDz1&amount=5&refcode=em20260422-1&t=1&akid=6250%2E582294%2EMh26ov)
Friend, I'm Ken Burns.
For more than five decades, I’ve devoted my life to telling the story of our nation through film -- our triumphs and our failures, our deepest divisions, and our hard-won progress.
From the American Revolution to the Civil War to World War II, from the Great Depression to the Great Society, one truth keeps repeating itself:
_Our democracy survives when people choose to protect it._
Today we are once again living through a hugely important moment in our nation’s history. The democratic values generations of Americans have fought so hard for are under attack.
**And here in New Hampshire, the stakes could not be higher.**
**[Before I share more, can you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help Chris Pappas defend this Senate seat and protect the future of our democracy?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260422_1.blmDz1&refcode=em20260422-1&t=2&akid=6250%2E582294%2EMh26ov)**

The Granite State has always played an outsized role in shaping our national story. Ours is a tradition of civic responsibility, open debate, and leaders who answer to the people -- not extremists or special interests. That’s why I’m proud to support Chris Pappas.
_Chris understands New Hampshire because he was born and raised here -- the Granite State is where we both call home._
In Congress he’s stood up for working families, protected Americans’ fundamental freedoms, and refused to bow to extremism.
The special interests and their billionaire allies know how important this open Senate seat is -- that’s why they’re flooding money into the state and backing a candidate who will promote their agenda.
_We cannot let that happen._
**[If you share my belief that our democracy is worth defending, I hope you’ll join me in supporting Chris Pappas today.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260422_1.blmDz1&refcode=em20260422-1&t=22&akid=6250%2E582294%2EMh26ov)**
Thank you for doing your part to keep the American story moving forward.

Ken Burns

body:
They are finally seeing that the plan is to drive farmers into bankruptcy and then help Big Ag and wealthy MAGA investors snap up their land at a discount.
| | | | | [](https://r6msg8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0010cRhaxbBHaQT1AT6wD2p3sa-6UByRr6WFspGPrUmxfxrQWsKFNuK7vLtryc2ddGYpe3cDNndQQyGc7MBCdBslvYi6cPaCRdRqMDCPUJBafbiKx-7lky1rTDrkTFzO8YDa21YU_IlmCB3P8HAqQX3pFaWjESx-ARKJK9D4MzzrX0n8r7czi933f2V8uzwTDT9JuuyIz1OUNy7yZKKHpoDRSqDFuhuvhg3&c=F1o-XN30gZQP1ZGO4izdyi175fW3s6cmxmdyDQKrMO-LDmGXrD6_WA==&ch=R6EWe5Pv2Wqbn2ucjRO5iQT24p_URXkV1Ppw-Q1CWz5bkscTWHiPxQ==)
---
Peter, Some of the cotton farmers I talk to stay in regular contact with Trump's people at the White House to see what's going on.
Farmers are facing the fiercest headwinds from Trump's disastrous handling of our economy. Trump has created a perfect storm that is ruining American farmers in record numbers, driving many to bankruptcy, desperation, and even suicide.
Those same folks I know are telling me that the best the Trump White House can come up with is to throw more money at a small fraction of farmers to help them try to weather that storm.
Unsurprisingly, Trump's only solution is another bailout--and an ineffective one at that.
That's why I am also hearing the scuttlebutt that many farmers (including longtime Republicans) are finally starting to see this for what it is: just another corrupt insider scheme to drive family farms into bankruptcy and then help Big Ag and wealthy MAGA investors snap up their farmland at a discount.
JD Vance invested early in a tech outfit called AcreTrader that buys up bankrupted farmers' land dirt cheap, and then facilitates sales for wealthy investors to turn huge profits.
It's private equity for family farms married with government corruption. And it is ruining the very people that families across America (and the world) rely on for fresh food.
---

clean_body: They are finally seeing that the plan is to drive farmers into bankruptcy and then help Big Ag and wealthy MAGA investors snap up their land at a discount. | | | | | == Peter, Some of the cotton farmers I talk to stay in regular contact with Trump's people at the White House to see what's going on. Farmers are facing the fiercest headwinds from Trump's disastrous handling of our economy. Trump has created a perfect storm that is ruining American farmers in record numbers, driving many to bankruptcy, desperation, and even suicide. Those same folks I know are telling me that the best the Trump White House can come up with is to throw more money at a small fraction of farmers to help them try to weather that storm. Unsurprisingly, Trump's only solution is another bailout--and an ineffective one at that. That's why I am also hearing the scuttlebutt that many farmers (including longtime Republicans) are finally starting to see this for what it is: just another corrupt insider scheme to drive family farms into bankruptcy and then help Big Ag and wealthy MAGA investors snap up their farmland at a discount. JD Vance invested early in a tech outfit called AcreTrader that buys up bankrupted farmers' land dirt cheap, and then facilitates sales for wealthy investors to turn huge profits. It's private equity for family farms married with government corruption. And it is ruining the very people that families across America (and the world) rely on for fresh food. | == If you don't know me, my name is Jamie Davis. I am the Louisiana farmer and Democrat running to flip Louisiana's US Senate seat this November. And I believe we are on the brink of a seismic shift that will realign politics for generations. I am not a politician--I have been a farmer my entire life. (I still am.) But even I know that change on this scale doesn't just happen. It takes organizing, hard work, and someone who can unite people who fundamentally disagree with each other around common ideals and values. In fact, I am confident that a politician actually would be unable to win this seat. I am deeply saddened by the passing of Congressman David Scott. For more than two decades, he answered the call to serve the people of Georgia’s 13th Congressional District with dedication and conviction, and his legacy of public service spans a lifetime of leadership — from the Georgia General Assembly to the halls of the United States Congress. My prayers are with Mrs. Alfredia Aaron Scott, the entire Scott family, and all of Congressman Scott’s loved ones as they mourn this loss. My thoughts are also with his dedicated staff and every resident of the 13th District who called him their Congressman. A community grieves today, and we grieve alongside it. Our community will come together and build upon his legacy. May his family be surrounded by love, may his staff be held with gratitude, and may the people of this district find comfort in the knowledge that his service mattered. Rest in peace, Congressman.

name: LCV Earth Day Alert
subject: This Earth Day: 4 urgent threats across the U.S. — and how you can help
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTM2NTMwNDYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjQ0MDM0NjU4NQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
We won’t mince words, Peter. Today is Earth Day, and public lands in
this country are under threat like never before. We’ve set a goal of mobilizing 422 people to renew their LCV membership for just $15. A group of donors will 3X MATCH your contribution, but only until midnight tonight >> https://links.messages.lcv. Right now, instead of celebrating the natural world, we’re mounting a defense
against a wave of coordinated attacks on our environment, impacting parks,
communities, and wildlife around the country: 📍In New Mexico:The Trump administration has fast-tracked revoking protections for Chaco Canyon
National Historic Park so that Big Oil can drill right up to the park's
boundaries, putting important archeological and cultural treasures at risk. 📍In Utah:MAGA Republicans are using Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument as a
trial run for a new way to revoke protections for national monuments: the
Congressional Review Act. If they’re successful, they will use this tool to hand
over even more national monuments to corporate polluters with a simple majority
vote. 📍In National Forests:The Trump administration is forcing the relocation of the National Forest
Service, pushing out thousands of career professionals dedicated to protecting
public lands and setting the table to open millions of acres of national forests
up to logging and development. 📍In the Gulf of Mexico: Trump is waiving Endangered Species Act protectionsfor marine wildlife in the Gulf of Mexico in order to fast-track offshore
drilling in prohibited habitats. We’re pushing back on all fronts, but we need sustained support to keep up. We need to mobilize 422 people who care about the future of our public lands to power our work this Earth Day. Please, triple your impact today by renewing your membership to help us hit our Earth Day goal. You’ll make an immediate impact to keep public lands in public hands — and right now, $15 is all it takes >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_ TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT TO PROTECT PUBLIC LANDS: RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP FOR $15 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT- Thank you for standing with us. When Steve Jobs died in 2011, the conventional wisdom was simple: no one could follow him. Jobs wasn't just a CEO. He was a once-in-a-generation visionary who had been fired and then returned to the brand that he had built, turning it from a struggling computer company into one of the most valuable and culturally significant corporations on earth. The idea that someone could step into his shoes and keep Apple at anywhere near the same level of excellence seemed absurd, almost impossible.
Tim Cook took the job anyway.
On paper, he was the perfect internal successor. As Chief Operating Officer, Cook had been the man who made the Apple machine run with ruthless efficiency. He was the logistics genius behind the supply chain that let Jobs' ideas actually reach the world. But efficiency is not the same as vision. For years, critics said the Cook era was too incremental, too safe, too focused on refining what already existed rather than inventing the next revolutionary product.
And yet, looking back as Cook steps down, **[the record is far more impressive than the complaints suggested.](https://substack.com/redirect/fa4a0c6c-d9b7-4d0b-b498-b80b683d1730?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Cook inherited an almost impossible task: follow one of the greatest business minds in history while navigating an industry that was changing faster than ever. Smartphones went from luxury items to everyday necessities. The entire role of technology in daily life shifted dramatically. Through all of it, Cook kept Apple not just alive, but extraordinarily profitable and culturally relevant while not being Steve Jobs. That is no small achievement.
